versets.translation: Maakan ɓe jaaboɗaa ɓe an Muhammad: Pellet, on immintinoyte ɓaawo nde on wontude mbullaari e ƴi'e woɗuɗe. Baabiraaɓe mon adinooɓe ɓen kadi wano non. On fow on immintiniroyte jaasere e hoyneede.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
versets.translation: Anndee ɗum, ko wuttaandu wooturu pet ka alaandu (ɗiɗaɓuru ndun) tawaa jaka yoo, fow maɓɓe hiɓe ndaara kulaleeji Ñalnde Darngal, hiɓe habbitii ko Alla huuwata ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Sirkooɓe fennunooɓe ummital ɓen wi'oya ontuma: Ee halkaare amen ! Ko ndee woni Ñalaande njoɓdi kuuɗe ɗen, nde Alla yoɓitaya jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, golle ɗe ɓe ardinnoo ka nguurndam maɓɓe aduna.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
versets.translation: Ɓe wi'anee ontuma: ko ndee tigiri, woni Ñalaande ñaawugol hakkunde jeyaaɓe ɓen, nde Ñalaande nde fennaynoɗon fii mun aduna.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
versets.translation: Malaa'ika'en wi'anee nden Ñalnde: Mooɓee sirkooɓe tooñirɓe sirku maɓɓe on, e gartooɓe maɓɓe ɓen ka sirkugol e ka fennugol, e ɗin sanamuuji ɗi ɓe rewaynoo ɓe acca Alla. Ɓe holloya ɓe laawol Yiite ngol, ɓe soggiroya ɓe ton, tawde ko ton woni jaaƴorde maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Malaa'ika'en wi'anee nden Ñalnde: Mooɓee sirkooɓe tooñirɓe sirku maɓɓe on, e gartooɓe maɓɓe ɓen ka sirkugol e ka fennugol, e ɗin sanamuuji ɗi ɓe rewaynoo ɓe acca Alla. Ɓe holloya ɓe laawol Yiite ngol, ɓe soggiroya ɓe ton, tawde ko ton woni jaaƴorde maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
versets.translation: Darnon ɓe fii ñaaweede, ado ɓe naadeede ka Yiite. Ɓaawo ɗum, soggiron ɓe ka Yiite.

versets.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
versets.translation: Ɓe feliroyee wi'aneede: ko heɓi on, on wallindirtaa hakkunde mon, wano wallindiraynoɗon aduna? Fewndo aaƴotoɗon wonnde sanamuuji mon ɗin walloyay on?

versets.arabic_text: بَلۡ هُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مُسۡتَسۡلِمُونَ
versets.translation: Ko woni kamɓe on hannde, ko ɓe doftiiii ɓe yamiroore Alla hoyɓe. Alaa ka ɓe wallindira, tawde ɓe alaa ɗum feere.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
versets.translation: Woɗɓe e maɓɓe fewtita yoga, ɓe wona e felindirgol wennjondira, ka ɗin ɗiɗi nafataa nden ñalnde.

versets.arabic_text: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
versets.translation: Jokkunooɓe ɓen wi'ana jokkanooɓe ɓen: ko onon ɓee koohooɓe, wonunoo ko ardiranaynoo men, ka baŋŋe diina e goonga; wonon e cuɗinangol men keeferaaku e sirkangol Alla e faggitagol geddi, doginon men e goonga ka Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen addunoo kan.

versets.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَل لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
versets.translation: Jokkanooɓe ɓen kadi jaabitoo ɓeya: wanaa non woniri. Ko woni kon, ko e keeferaaku wonunoɗon, on meeɗaali wonnde gomɗimɓe, wurin, ko on yeddunooɓe wonunoo.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا طَٰغِينَ
versets.translation: Doole woo men alanaano on e hoore ko jokkunoɗon men kon, haa men yolla on e keeferaaku maa sirku maa faggitagol geddi. Si ko woni, on wonuno yimɓe fantimɓe e yeddugol e majjere.

versets.arabic_text: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
versets.translation: Koongol Joomi men ngol ka kammbol Makko wiide: "Mi hebbiniroyte Jahannama, e kala ɓen jokku ɓe ma" (Cortewol Saad, aaya 85), ko haanungol jojjude; ɗum holli, ko en meeɗooɓe ko Joomi men kammbiri kon, feere mun alaa.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَغۡوَيۡنَٰكُمۡ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
versets.translation: Men nodduno on e majjere e keeferaaku, tawde non, ko men majjunoo laawol goonga ngol, wonunoo.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
versets.translation: Jokkuɓe e jokkanooɓe nden ñalnde, fow ko hawtoyteeɓe ka lepte.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
versets.translation: Ko wano nii Men huuwirta ɓee bomɓe, ka meeɗinirgol ɓe lepte ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
versets.translation: Ɓee sirkooɓe si wi'ananooma aduna: Rewteeɗo alaa si wanaa Alla, fii gollitirgol ngol konngol, sela kala ko lunndii ngol, ɓe salora ɗoftagol ɗum, townitanagol goonga kan.

versets.arabic_text: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
versets.translation: Ɓe hujjinora keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun, wiide: kere men accitiray reweteeɗi amen ɗin, fii yimoowo haangaaɗo? Wiide ɓe ɗum, ko Nulaaɗo Alla on ɓe faandii (yo o his).

versets.arabic_text: بَلۡ جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
versets.translation: Ko ɓe tukkiri Nulaaɗo on kon hino ñiddi. Tawde pellet, Nulaaɗo jom kisiyee on, meeɗaali wonnde haangaaɗo, wanaa yimmowo. Ko woni goonga, ko wiide ko Alqur'aanaare o ardi, noddaynde e wootinɗongol Alla, jokka Nulaaɗo Makko on. Nulaaɗo on non, o goonginii ɓeya Nulaaɓe, e ko ɓe addunoo kon, immorde ka Alla, immorde e tawhiidi, e tabintingol ummital. O lunndakki e ɗum.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّكُمۡ لَذَآئِقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَلِيمِ
versets.translation: Onon ɓee sirkooɓe, pellet, ko on meeɗay lepte muusuɗe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal, sabu keeferaaku mun ngun e fennugol Nulaaɓe ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
versets.translation: Onon ɓee sirkooɓe, on yoɓitoytaake, si wanaa yeru kon ko huuwaynoɗon aduna, e yeddugol Alla, faggitoo geddi.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
versets.translation: Jeyaaɓe Alla gomɗimɓe, ɓen ɓe Alla laɓɓiniri fii ko rewa Mo, ɓe laɓɓinani Mo dewal ngal, ɓen ɗon daɗoyay e ɗen lepte.

versets.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
versets.translation: Hino woodani ɓen jeyaaɓe laɓɓinaaɓe, fanndaari ndi Alla arsikata ɓe, tinndiraandi laaɓugol e labegol e duumagol mun.

versets.arabic_text: فَوَٰكِهُ وَهُم مُّكۡرَمُونَ
versets.translation: Oon arsuka ko muuyanteeɗi ceertuɗi ɓurɗi laaɓude, ko ɓe nafoo, e hoore ɗum, ko ɓe teddiniraaɓe mbarjaari toowundi, e yi'ugol yeeso Alla teddungo ngon.

versets.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
versets.translation: Ɓe heɓay ɗin fow, ka Aljannaaji neeminiiɗi, ñiiɓuɗi, tabituɗi, ɗi taƴondirtaa, sakko lanna.

versets.arabic_text: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
versets.translation: hara hiɓe waalii tuugi fewntondiri e hoore danɗe.

versets.arabic_text: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِكَأۡسٖ مِّن مَّعِينِۭ
versets.translation: Hara kore sanngara hino wannginee e maɓɓe, laaɓinrɗam wano ndiyam iloojam.

versets.arabic_text: بَيۡضَآءَ لَذَّةٖ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
versets.translation: Ranwudam mbaadi , lewñunde na dakmitoo heen e kala yarooɓe nde.

versets.arabic_text: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلٞ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
versets.translation: On sanngara, nanndaa e sanngara aduna on, tawde ɗam sottintaa haqqil, wanaa muusinayɗam kadi hoore. Ko hisinayɗam ɓanndu e haqqille kala yaruɗo ɗam.

versets.arabic_text: وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ عِينٞ
versets.translation: Hino woodani ɓe ka Aljanna ton: rewɓe ɓe alaa e ɗuuɗa giteyaagal worbe janbe, yooɗa giteeɓe.

versets.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيۡضٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
versets.translation: Ɓen rewɓe no wa'i wa boofo soomaaɗa maraa sabu ranwude, ɗe junngo meemaali.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
versets.translation: Yoga e yimɓe Aljanna ɓe fewtita yoga, ɓe lamndondira fii ko feƴƴi aduna.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ قَآئِلٞ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٞ
versets.translation: Goɗɗo e ɓen gomɗimɓe wi'a: Min miɗo marunoo wonndiiɗo yeddaynooɗo ummital ka aduna.

versets.arabic_text: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصَدِّقِينَ
versets.translation: Wi'anaynooɗo lam, e hoore yeddugol jalkita: kere an wonndiiɗo, hiɗa jeyaa e goongimɓe immintineede maayɓe ɓen?

versets.arabic_text: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
versets.translation: Eyoo si en maayii, en wontii mbulmbulndi e ƴi'e kiɗɗe, haray ko en immintinoyteeɓe yoɓitee njoɓdi golle men ɗen aduna?

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ هَلۡ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
versets.translation: Wondinooɗo makko gomɗimɓe on, wi'ana wonndiiɓe mun ɓen ka Aljanna: on ƴeewiday e am, anndugol battane wonndinooɗo lam yeddunooɗo ummital on?

versets.arabic_text: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Kanko o ƴeewa, o haynoo wondinooɗo makko on, ka tummbere Dulbunge.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
versets.translation: o wi'a: mi woondirii Alla ! An oo wondinooɗo lam, a eɓɓuno halkitirgol fii am, naatugol Yiite, sabu ko noodiraynoɗaa lam e keeferaaku, yedda fii ummital.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa moƴƴere Alla nden e am, woni sabu mi feewiri gomɗinal, mi tawdeteno e lepteteeɓe ɓen, wano maa.

versets.arabic_text: أَفَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
versets.translation: Wonaa non enen yimɓe Aljanna ɓen, en maayataa.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
versets.translation: En maayataa, si wanaa maayde men aranere nden aduna. Wurin ko en duumotooɓe ka Aljanna, en wonaali kadi lepteteeɓe, wano yedduɓe ɓen huuwirtee.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
versets.translation: Pellet, ko ndii njoɓdi ndi Joomi men warjori en naatugol duumoo Aljanna, daɗa Yiite ɗoo, woni maloore mawnunde nden, nde yeru mun alaa.

versets.arabic_text: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
versets.translation: Ko fii sugu ndii njoɓdi mawndi ɗoo, woni ko waɗɗii nde gollooɓe gollanta. Tawde ko ndii woni ngeyngu tonatoongu.

versets.arabic_text: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
versets.translation: Hara ko on neema mo Alla marani jeyaaɓe Makko laɓɓinan ɓe Mo dawal ɓen, ɓuri moƴƴude jipporde e teddungal, kaa ko leggal "Zaqquumi" huɗaangal ka Alqur'aana ngal? Tawngal ko ñaametee heeferɓe ɓen, ngal fayintaa ngal duncataa e ittugol heege!

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
versets.translation: Men waɗii ngal leggal, jarrabuyee, wonannde tooñirɓe geddi e keeferaaku ɓen. Tawde ɓe wi'uno: Yiite ñaamay leɗɗe, ɗum holli, leggal fuɗataa ka Yiite.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٞ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Laggal zaqquumi ngal, ko yaltirayngal ka kaaniri: ko ka tummbere Dulbunge, ngal yaltirta.

versets.arabic_text: طَلۡعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
versets.translation: Dimɗe ngal leggal, hino kaaniri nannditi wa ko'e seytanuuji. Si hunnde non kaanii, ko ɗum woni nde kaanii kadi kabaaru; ɗum holli, ñaametee maggal on, ko ko ñiddi.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
versets.translation: Kamɓe heeferɓe ɓen, pellet, ko e dimɗe ngal leggal haaɗungal, woni ko ɓe dekkirta, ɓe hebbinira deedi maɓɓe heegaaɗi.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبٗا مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ
versets.translation: Refti hino woodani e caggal nyaamgol leggal ngal, njaram, jillaaɗam, fatinaaɗam haa ñiddi.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Refti ruttorde maɓɓe nden, ko ka lepte Dulɓoowe: ɓe iwa e lepte, ɓe yaha e lepte.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
versets.translation: Ɓee heeferɓe, ɓe tawu baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen, majjunooɓe laawol peewal ngol; ɓe jokkitii ɗon, ko aldaa e hujja.

versets.arabic_text: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
versets.translation: Ɓe woni e yaccagol jokka batteeji majjere baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen ko yaawi.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii ko ɓuri ɗuuɗde e aramɓe ɓen, majjiino, ado maɓɓe. Wanaa yimɓe maa ɓen, an Nulaaɗo, adii majjude e mofte ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii le, Men nunulo e ɗen mofte adinooɓe, Nulaaɓe, ko jertina e lepte Alla ɗen, kono ɓe yeddi.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
versets.translation: Ndaaru an Nulaaɗo, ko honno baɗtane ɓen jertinanooɓe salii, no wa'unoo! Ko Yitte ɓe sakkitori naatude, luttirooɓe ton, sabu salaare e fennugol ɓe Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa jeyaaɓe Alla, laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen; ko ɓen ɗon daɗoyta lepte ɗen ɗe ɓeya heeferɓe yeddunoo waɗtiniroya.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٞ فَلَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡمُجِيبُونَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Nuuhu nodduno Men (yo o his) fewndo yimɓe makko ɓen fennunoo mo, e hoore ko o noddi ɓe e mun kon, iskin ko Men woni moƴƴuɓe noototooɓe. Tawde Men yaccinno toraare makko nden e maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
versets.translation: Men daɗndi mo, kanko e ɓeynguure makko nden, wondude e gomɗimɓe mo ɓen, lorra yimɓe makko, e yoolagol tuufaan ngol, nelangol ngol e yimɓe makko yeddunooɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلۡبَاقِينَ
versets.translation: Men daɗndi ɓeynguure makko makko nden e gomɗimɓe mo ɓen tun. Ɓeya kan, Men yooliri ɓeya keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun.

versets.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
versets.translation: Men heddinani mo e mofte hikkotooɗe ɗen, mantoore moƴƴere, nde ɓe mantirta mo.

versets.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٖ فِي ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: Nuuhu hisii o daɗii wowleede bone, e mofte sakkitiiɗe ɗen. Wurin, mantoore e jantoore moƴƴere, heddoto fii makko.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Ko sugu ndii njoɓdi, ndi Men warjorii Annabi Nuuhu, woni ko Men warjorta moƴƴinooɓe dewe mun ɗen, ɓe rewi Alla tun.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
versets.translation: Kanko Nuuhu, ko o jeyanooɗo e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe, woni e ɗoftaare Alla ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
versets.translation: Refti Men yooliri hedditiiɓe ɓen, waame mbo Men wurti e maɓɓe on. Ɓe fow maɓɓe ɓe gasi.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
versets.translation: Awa Ibraahiima, ko jeyanooɗo e jokkuɓe diina makko, rewi laawol makko ka wootinɗingol Alla.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٍ
versets.translation: Janto nde o ardunoo ka Joomi makko, ɓernde hisunde e sirku, laaɓanɗo Alla e tagu Makko ngun.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
versets.translation: Nde o maakannoo baaba makko e yimɓe mun sirkaynooɓe ɓen: Ko honɗum rewton gaanin Alla?

versets.arabic_text: أَئِفۡكًا ءَالِهَةٗ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
versets.translation: E ko reweteeɗi fefindaaɗi, faalaɗon rewude ko wanaa Alla?

versets.arabic_text: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: Ko sikkuɗon, onon yimɓe am, e Joomiraawo tageefo ngon, si on hawroyii e Makko, hara on rewaano Mo? Ko sikkuɗon O gollata on ontuma?

versets.arabic_text: فَنَظَرَ نَظۡرَةٗ فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
versets.translation: Annabi Ibraahiima ndaariri ka koode, himo taskoo ɗaɓɓa feere, no daɗira yaltidugol e maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ
versets.translation: O ngantinori yaltidugol e yimɓe makko ɓen ka iidi maɓɓe, wiide: ko mi nawnuɗo.

versets.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
versets.translation: Ɓe acci mo caggal ɗon, ɓe hucciti.

versets.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
versets.translation: O moltii e reweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗin gaanin Alla, o jalnori ɗi maakugol: E on ñaamataa ko sirkanooɓe on ɓen moƴƴinani on kon?

versets.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
versets.translation: Ko heɓi on, on wowlataa, on jaabotaako? Ko sugu ɗum ɗoo rewetee gaanin Alla?

versets.arabic_text: فَرَاغَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ضَرۡبَۢا بِٱلۡيَمِينِ
versets.translation: Ibraahiima moltorani ɗi, piyirgol ɗi junngo makko ñaamo ngon, fii muncugol ɗi.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَقۡبَلُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ يَزِفُّونَ
versets.translation: Rewaynooɓe ɗin sanamuuji ɓen, fewri ka makko, hiɓe yaawno.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
versets.translation: Ibraahiima fewtitiri ɓe tabitaal, o feli ɓe, o maaki: E on reway kon ko lesirɗon juuɗe mon, accon Alla?

versets.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ
versets.translation: Ko Alla tagi on, O tagi golle mon ɗen, wano ɗin sanamuuji ɗi leston. Ko Kanko tun hanndi e Mo rewon, hara on renndidaani Mo e goɗɗum goo.

versets.arabic_text: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Nde ɓe ronkunoo teeɗoragol mo hujja, ɓe yahri doole, ɓe diisonsiri haa ɓe fottani ko ɓe waɗata ibraahiima; ɓe wi'i: mahanee mo maadi, hebbiniron ndi carma, huɓɓon ɗe yiite, refti buɗon mo ton.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
versets.translation: Yimɓe Annabi Ibraahiima ɓen faandanii mo bone, no ɓe gaynira fii makko,ɓe ɓoortondira e makko, kono Men waɗi ɓe kamɓe sooyuɓe ɓen; nde Men waɗannoo mo yiite ngen ɓuuɓol e kisiyee.

versets.arabic_text: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
versets.translation: Ibraahiima maaki: Min on, ko mi feroowo ka Joomi am, mi yalta e leydi yimɓe am ɓen, no mi heɓira feere rewugol Mo; aray nde O fewnata lam e ko moƴƴanta lam aduna e laakara.

versets.arabic_text: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
versets.translation: Joomi am, arsikam ɓiɗɗo moƴƴo, ko wallitoo lam, semmbina lam e yimɓe am ɓen, tuma mi ferata.

versets.arabic_text: فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٖ
versets.translation: Men jaabiniri toraare makko nden, humpitugol mo ko welata mo, fewndo Men wewlinirnii mo geɗaljo mawnoowo, muññoytooɗo; on woni Ismaa'iila (yo o his).

versets.arabic_text: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
versets.translation: Nde Ismaa'iila mawnunoo, o yottodi e ben makko jahal, ben makko Ibraahiima hoyɗi, koyɗol Annabaaɓe ɓen non, ko wahayu. O humpiti geɗal makko wiide mo: ko an yo ɓiɗɗo am, mi yi'ii e koyɗol, wonnde miɗo hirse. Ndaaru ko yi'uɗaa e ɗum. Ismaa'iila jaabii baaba'en mun, wiide: Baaba'en, waɗee ko yamiraɗon kon fii hirsugol lam, on taway lam, si Alla jaɓii, jeyaaɗo e muñooɓe e weltorɓe ñaawoore Alla nden.

versets.arabic_text: فَلَمَّآ أَسۡلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلۡجَبِينِ
versets.translation: Nde ɓe jebbilaninoo yamiroore Alla nden, Ibraahiima hippiri geɗal makko, tiinde nden, fii hirsugol mo.

versets.arabic_text: وَنَٰدَيۡنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
versets.translation: Men noddi Ibraahiima fewndo o hittiniraynoo waɗugol yamiroore Alla nden, ka hirsugol geɗaljo makko on, wiide: ko an yo Ibraahiima!

versets.arabic_text: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Pellet, a laatinirii koyɗol maa ngol, fiɓugol hirsude geɗaljo maa on. Awa ko wano Men yoɓitirt maa non firtingol ma nden huunde saɗtunde, woni ko Men yoɓitirta moƴƴinooɓe ɓen; Men ɓoora ɓe e kulaleeji e saɗteendeeji.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلۡبَلَٰٓؤُاْ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
versets.translation: Pellet, ko ɗum ɗoo woni jarrabuyee ɓannguɗo on. Ibraahiima hawrii e mun.

versets.arabic_text: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
versets.translation: Men soktiri Ismaa'iila, dammol mawnungol, ko hirsee, hara wanaa kanko.

versets.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
versets.translation: Men accani Ibraahiima, mantoore labaande, e mofte sakkitiiɗe ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
versets.translation: Alla hiwrike mo, O du'anike mo kadi kisal e kala lorra.

versets.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Ko wano Men yoɓitiri Ibraahiima e ɗoftaare makko nden, Men yoɓitirta moƴƴinooɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
versets.translation: Kanko Ibraahiima, ko o jeyanooɗo e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe, hunnuɓe sifaaji jeyeede Alla.

versets.arabic_text: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
versets.translation: Men wewlintiniri mo geɗaljo goo, wonoowo Annabaajo, e jeyaaɗo moƴƴo; on woni Ishaaqa. Ɗum ko njoɓdi ɗoftagol mo Alla ngol, ka hirsugol Ismaa'iila, ɓiɗɗo makko bajjo on nun.

versets.arabic_text: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
versets.translation: Men jippini barki e makko, e dow geɗal makko Ishaaqa. Men ɗuɗɗinani ɓe neema; wano ɗuuɗireede ɓiɗɓe. Hino e geyngol maɓɓe ngol non, moƴƴinɗo ɗoftagpl Joomi mun, e tooñirɗo hoore-mun yeddugol faggitoo ɓanngina bone.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Men moƴƴorike e dow Muusaa, e nene gooto makko on Haaruuna, Annabaaku ngun.

versets.arabic_text: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُمَا وَقَوۡمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
versets.translation: Men daɗndi ɓe, kamɓe e yimɓe maɓɓe ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, maccinireede Fir'awna, e yoolagol.

versets.arabic_text: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
versets.translation: Men walli ɓe e Fir'awna e konu mun, ɓe fooli ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَبِينَ
versets.translation: Men okki Muusaa e neene gooto makko on Haaruuna, Deftere Tawreeta nden, immorde ka Alla, ɓanngunde, nde jilɓuya alah e mayre.

versets.arabic_text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ
versets.translation: Men fewniri ɓe, e laawol focciingol ngol. Ngol woni laawol diina lislaamu kan, ɗowirayngol e welayee seniiɗo taguɗo On.

versets.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمَا فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
versets.translation: Men accani ɓe mantoore e jantoore labaande, e mofte sakkitiiɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
versets.translation: Alla hiwrorike ɓe hiwraandu teddundu, O mantii ɓe, O du'oranike ɓe hisugol e kala bone.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Ko wano Men yoɓitiri non Muusaa e Haaruuna, woni ko Men yoɓitirta moƴƴinooɓe ɗfotagol Joomi mun ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمَا مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
versets.translation: Muusaa e Haaruuna, ko jeyanooɓe e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe Alla, golliri sari'a Makko on.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ إِلۡيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
versets.translation: Pellet, Ilyaasa kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen. Alla moƴƴorino e makko Annabaaku e Nulal.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
versets.translation: Janto nde o maakannoo yimɓe mako ɓen o nulaa e mun ɓen, ka ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, e on hulirtaa Alla ɗoftagol yamirooje Makko ɗen, wano wootinɗingol Mo, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, wano sirku?

versets.arabic_text: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلٗا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
versets.translation: E on reway sanamuuru mon wi'eteende "Ba'ala" ndun, accon ɗon Alla, ɓurɗo moƴƴude tagu On?

versets.arabic_text: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
versets.translation: Ko Alla woni Joomi mon, woni taguɗo on, O tagi baabiraaɓe mon ɓen ado ɗum. Ko On hanndi e reweede, wanaa goɗɗum goo, wano sanamuuji mon, ɗi duncataa ɗi lorrataa.

versets.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
versets.translation: Yimɓe makko ɓen alaa waɗi, si wanaa fennugol mo. Awa ɗum wonay sabu ɓe tawnoyteebe e lepte ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa ɓen yimɓe makko gomɗinnooɓe laɓɓini dewe mun ɓen, ɓen ɗon daɗoyay tawnoyeede e lepte ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: وَتَرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
versets.translation: Men accani mo mantoore e jantoore labaande, e mofte sakkitiiɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلۡ يَاسِينَ
versets.translation: Alla hiwrike mantii Ilyaasna'en.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Ko wano Men yoɓitiri non Ilyaasa'en, woni ko Men yoɓitirta jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe moƴƴinooɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
versets.translation: Kanko Ilyaasa, ko o jeyanooɗo e jeyaaɓe Amen gomɗimɓe goongini gomɗingol Joomi mun.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لُوطٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
versets.translation: Pellet, Luutu kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen nuliranooɓe e yimɓe mun, wewlingol e jertingol.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ نَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
versets.translation: Janto nde Men daɗndunoo mo, kanko e ɓeynguure makko nden fow, e lepte wurtanooɗe e yimɓe makko ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا عَجُوزٗا فِي ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa debbo makko on, on jeyano e yimɓe makko leptaaɓe ɓen; tawde ko o yedunooɗo.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ دَمَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
versets.translation: Refti Men halki fennunooɓe mo, heddii ɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّكُمۡ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيۡهِم مُّصۡبِحِينَ
versets.translation: Onon yimɓe Makkah ɓen non, hiɗon rewa e galleeji maɓɓe, tuma setorton Saami, e dawol mon.

versets.arabic_text: وَبِٱلَّيۡلِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
versets.translation: Hiɗon rewa e hoore-maɓɓe kadi, ka jemma. E on haqqiltaa, waajitoron ko heɓi ɓe kon, ɓaawo ɓe fennude ɓe yedda ɓe faggitoo bonunnda mo adaaka e mun?

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
versets.translation: Pellet, Yuunusa kadi, ko jeyanooɗo e Nulaaɓe Alla ɓen nuliranooɓe e yimɓe mun, wewlingol e jertingol.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
versets.translation: Janto nde o dogunoo yimɓe makko ɓen, ko aldaa e duŋayee Joomi makko. O waɗɗoyii laana hebbiniraaka yimɓe e dolle.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُدۡحَضِينَ
versets.translation: Laana kan eɓɓi yoolagol, hakkee ko ka heewi. Ɓe urbinii nder ton, ndaarugol ko homɓe gasetee bugedee ka maayo, fii ɗuytugol teddeendi makka ndin; Yuunusa jeyaa e ɓen foolaaɓe ka urba, ɓe bugii mo ka maayo.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
versets.translation: Nde ɓe buginoo mo ka maayo, linngii ngii moɗi mo, fewndo ka o felnii; tawde o yehii ka maayo, o duŋinaaki e Joomi makko.

versets.arabic_text: فَلَوۡلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaano tawde Yuunusa ko jeyanooɗo e jantotooɓe Alla ko ɗuuɗi, si wanaano subbunhinagol makko ngol ka nder reedu lingii ngii

versets.arabic_text: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
versets.translation: O ñiiɓayno ka reedu lingii ngii, haa Ñalnde Darngal, ɗon wona yenaande makko.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٞ
versets.translation: Men sorti mo e reedu lingii ngii, Men werlii mo ka ladde, ko o lo'uɗo, battane ko o ɓooyi kon ka reedu maggii.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ شَجَرَةٗ مِّن يَقۡطِينٖ
versets.translation: Men fuɗinani mo e e ladde yeewnde nde, leggal buudi, ka o ɗuwora o ñaama.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
versets.translation: Men nuli mo e yimɓe makko hawraynooɓe: ujune teemedere maa ɓuri ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
versets.translation: Ɓe gomɗini mo, ɓe goongini ko o addi kon, Alla dakmiti ɓe e nguurndam maɓɓe aduna ɗam, haa dumunna maɓɓe on timmi.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
versets.translation: Muhammad, lamndorii ɓee sirkooɓe "ŋiñugol": E on waɗanay Alla ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ɓe añanɗon hoore-mon, heertinanon ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓen fii mon? Ko honɗum e senndoore nii?

versets.arabic_text: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
versets.translation: Ko honno ɓe aaƴorta wonnde Malaa'ika'en ko rewɓe, ɓe tawanooka tageede majji, ɓe seeditaaki ɗum?

versets.arabic_text: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنۡ إِفۡكِهِمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ
versets.translation: Pellet sirkuɓe ɓe e pennugol mum en e fepindaade ɓe penaale e dow Alla ɓe ngaskina ɓiɗɗo e dow Makko, ɓe ko fenooɓe e koɓe noddittoo ko.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
versets.translation: Pellet sirkuɓe ɓe e pennugol mum en e fepindaade ɓe penaale e dow Alla ɓe ngaskina ɓiɗɗo e dow Makko, ɓe ko fenooɓe e koɓe noddittoo ko.

versets.arabic_text: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ
versets.translation: Hara Allah suɓan hoore Makko, ɓiɗɓe rewɓe ɓen ɓe añanɗon hoore-mon, e dow ɓiɗɓe worɓe ɓe yiɗanɗon hoore-mon ɓen? Kallaa! wanaa non!

versets.arabic_text: مَا لَكُمۡ كَيۡفَ تَحۡكُمُونَ
versets.translation: Ko heɓi on, onon ɓee sirkooɓe, hiɗon ñaawira ndee ñaaaworaa ooñiinde, waɗanon Alla ɓiɗɓe rewɓe, suɓaoɗon hoore-mon worɓe ɓen?

versets.arabic_text: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.translation: E on miijitotaako wonnde ko e meere wonɗon e mun? Tawde si on taskike, on yi'iray non bonnde fiɓnde mon nden.

versets.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ سُلۡطَٰنٞ مُّبِينٞ
versets.translation: Kaa hiɗon jogii hujja e dalil ɓanngirɗo Deftere maa Nulaaɗo?

versets.arabic_text: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
versets.translation: Haray addee deftere mon ka hujja mon on woni ɗon, si wonii ko on goonguɓe e haala!

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
versets.translation: Sirkooɓe ɓen waɗi hakkunde Allah e Malaa'ika'en, asko dammbe, ɗum ko ko ɓe aaƴinoo wonnde Malaa'ika'en, ko ɓiɗɓe Allah rewɓe! Hara non, ɓen Malaa'ikaaɓe no anndi, pellet, Alla tawnoyay ɓen sirkooɓe, e hasboore nden.

versets.arabic_text: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
versets.translation: Allah senike O laaɓii, gaay e kon sirkooɓe ɓen sifotoo, dammbude Mo ɓiɗɗo e genndiraawo, ekw immorde e ka yahdaa e Makko!

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa jeyaaɓe Allah, laɓɓinaaɓe ɓen. Ɓen ɗon sifortaa Allah, ko yahdaani e Makko.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
versets.translation: Anndon onon ɓee sirkooɓe, e ko rewoton kon gaanin Allah.

versets.arabic_text: مَآ أَنتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
versets.translation: On wonaali majjinirooɓe kon ko rewoton, woɗɓe goo e diine goonga.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Si wanaa on mo Allah winndani naatugol ka Yiite. On ɗon yeddiray saɓu ɗum, o naata nge. Onon non, e reweteeɗi mon ɗin, on alaa nden feere.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
versets.translation: Malaa'ika'en ɓanngini jeyeede maɓɓe ka Allah, daɗndinoo e ko sirkooɓe ɓen aaƴoriɓe kon, wi'ugol: Alaa e amen, mo alanaa ɗum, darorde anndaande, fii rewugol Alla ɗoftoo Mo.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
versets.translation: Menen Malaa'ika, ko men darnaaɓe saffinaa, fii rewugol Allah ɗoftoo Mo. Ko memen kadi woni subbunhinantooɓe Allah ɓen, sifaaji yahduɗi e Makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡمُسَبِّحُونَ
versets.translation: Menen Malaa'ika, ko men darnaaɓe saffinaa, fii rewugol Allah ɗoftoo Mo. Ko memen kadi woni seninooɓe Allah ko O haandaani ko sifaaji.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِن كَانُواْ لَيَقُولُونَ
versets.translation: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
versets.translation: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
versets.translation: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: فَكَفَرُواْ بِهِۦۖ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
versets.translation: Sirkooɓe Makkah ɓen woniino e wi'ugol, ado nuleede Muhammadu (yo o his): Sinno hara meɗen joginoo Deftere sugu Defte arane ɗen, wano Tawreeta, ko pellet, men laɓɓinanayno Alla dewalngal. Hara non, ko e fenaande ɓe woni. Tawde Muhammadu addanii ɓe Alqur'aana, ɓe yeddi nde. Kono non, aray nde ɓe anndata, fii lepte saɗtuɗe, haɓɓiiɗe ɓe ɗen, Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ سَبَقَتۡ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, wonnde ko ɓe wallirteeɓe e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hujja e dolle ɗe Alla neeminiri ɓe. E wonnde poolal ngal, ko fii konu Amen, haɓirayngu fii Alla ngun, no daalol Alla ngol ɓamtora.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ لَهُمُ ٱلۡمَنصُورُونَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, wonnde pellet, ko ɓe wallirteeɓe e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hujja e dolle ɗe Alla neeminiri ɓe. E wonnde poolal ngal, ko fii konu Amen, haɓirayngu fii Alla ngun, no daalol Alla ngol ɓamtora.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Konngol Amen ardinoke, fii Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, wonnde ko ɓe wallirteeɓe e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen, hujja e dolle ɗe Alla neeminiri ɓe. E wonnde poolal ngal, ko fii konu Amen, haɓirayngu fii Alla ngun, no daalol Alla ngol ɓamtora.

versets.arabic_text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, ɗuurno ɓee sirkooɓe saɗta feereeɓe, haa e saanga nde Allah humpitu maa, arugol lepte maɓɓe ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَبۡصِرۡهُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
versets.translation: Ndaaraa ɓe, tuma lepte ɗen jippotoo e maɓɓe, ɓe aray yi'ude, ka yi'ugol nafataa ɓe!

versets.arabic_text: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَ
versets.translation: E hara ko lepte Alla ɗen, ɓee sirkooɓe heñorta?

versets.arabic_text: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
versets.translation: Si lepte Allah ɗen jippike e maɓɓe, haray bimmbi maɓɓe on bonii !

versets.arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, ɗuurno e maɓɓe, haa Allah ñaawa fii leptugol ɓe ngol.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَبۡصِرۡ فَسَوۡفَ يُبۡصِرُونَ
versets.translation: Ndaaraa; kamɓe kadi, ɓe aray yi'ude lepte Allah ɗen yanooje e maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
versets.translation: Senayee woodanii Joomi maa, an Muhammadu, O laaɓii e kon ko sirkooɓe ɓen siforta Mo e ustiiɗi !

versets.arabic_text: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
versets.translation: Kisiyee Allah e mantoore Makko, wonii e Nulaaɓe Makko tedduɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: Yettoore nden fow, woodanii Alla seniiɗo toowuɗo On. Ko Kanko hanndi e ɗum. Ko Kanko woni Jeyɗo winndere nden fow. Jeyɗo ɗum alaa, si wanaa Kanko.

versets.arabic_text: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
versets.translation: Saad: yewtere yawtiino, fii sugu ɗee karfe taƴondirɗe, ka fuɗɗorde simoore Baqarah. E ngol cortewol ɗoo, Allah no woodanira Alqur'aana, yowondirnde e waajitorɗi yimɓe, kon ko nafata ɓe aduna e laakara. Hara wanaa ko sirkooɓe ɓen aaƴotoo, wonnde Allah no mai denndadiijo.

versets.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
versets.translation: Ko woni kon, heeferɓe ɓen wonii e townitanagol wootinɗinnde Allah, e luutondirgol e Muhammadu (yo o his), e anygol mo.

versets.arabic_text: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٖ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٖ
versets.translation: Ɗuuɗii e mofte fennuɓe Nulaaɓe mun, ado maɓɓe, ɓe Men halki, ɓen noddi faaboo uma, nde lepte tellato, kono oon waqtu wonaana waqtu faabeede e lepte sakko faabo nafa ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٞ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٌ
versets.translation: Ɓe ŋalɗi, tuma ɓe yi'unoo Nulaaɗo arɗo ɓe on, ko jertina ɓe e lepte Allah ɗen, ko e maɓɓe o jeyaa. Yedduɓe ɓen nde yi'unoo hujjaaji ɓannginɗi goonga Muhammadu kan, ɓe wi'i: Oo, ko biloowo yimɓe nii, heewuɗo fenaande e ko wi'ata kon, wonnde ko o Nulaaɗo, mo Allah wahayini e mun.

versets.arabic_text: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
versets.translation: Kere o waɗay reweteeɗi limtilimtiɗi e mun ɗin fow, reweteeɗo gooto tun? Pellet, ko huunde haɗtirnde haawnagol non.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٞ يُرَادُ
versets.translation: Mbatu maɓɓe ngun hucciti, ɓe wi'ani yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen: Yehee, jokkon haaju mun, wata on naatu e diina Muhammadu, tabitee e reweteeɗi mon ɗin. Anndon ko Muhammadu noddi on e mun kon, wiide yo on rewu gooto tun, ko ko o eɓɓani, fii no o waawira'en, waɗten jokkude mo.

versets.arabic_text: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
versets.translation: Men nanaali fii ko Muhammadu noddata men e mun kon, woni bajjinɗingol Allah ngol, e diina baabiraaɓe amen ɓen, wanaa e diina Iisaa kan. Ko men naniri mo kon wonaali, si wanaa fenaande fefindaande.

versets.arabic_text: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
versets.translation: Kere ko e makko Alqur'aana jippintee hakkunde amen, o heertora ɗum e hoore amen, menen koohooɓe ɓen? Si ko woni, ɓee sirkooɓe wonii e sikkitagol wayahu mo mi jippini e maaɗa on. Fotde ɓe meeɗaali lepte Allah ɗen, kono hiɓe ɗayintora nennitaneede ɓe. Si ɓe meeɗuno lepte ɗen, ɓe haɓɓitotanooko e yeddugol sirkana Allah, sikkitoo e ko O wahayini kon e maaɗa.

versets.arabic_text: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
versets.translation: Kaa ɓee sirkooɓe fennooɓe jogiti ngaluuji ɓure Joomi maa, Fooluɗo Mo fooletaake On, Okkoowo mo O muuyani yeɗude. Wano ngalu ngu O yeɗirta Annabaaku, on mo O muuyani. Tawde wanaa kamɓe ɗum wonani, sakko ɓe yeɗa mo ɓe yiɗani, maa ɓe ɗala goɗɗo goo.

versets.arabic_text: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
versets.translation: Kaa ko kamɓe woodani laamagol kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e kon ko woni hakkunde majji? Sakko ɓe heɓa feere yeɗugol e ɗawugol! Si ko non ɓe aaƴori, haray yo ɓe ƴeenŋir kala sabu no ɓe hewtiryta ka kammuuli, fii no ɓe ñaawira ko ɓe yiɗi, woni yeɗugol maa ɗalugol. Kono ɓe hippataa ɗum!

versets.arabic_text: جُندٞ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
versets.translation: Ɓee fennooɓe Muhammadu jom kisiyee on, ko konu hoyngu, fooliroyteengu wano ɗiya feddeeji fennunooɗi Nulaaɓe mun, ado maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
versets.translation: Wanaa ɓee woni ko adii fennude. Woɗɓe adinoke ɓe e ɗum, woni Yimɓe Nuuhu ɓen, e Aadi'en e Fir'awna lettiraynooɗo yimɓe ɓen, pempe.

versets.arabic_text: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
versets.translation: Samuuda'en kadi, e yimɓe Luutu ɓen, e yimɓe Shu'aybu ɓen fow kadi fenni Nulaaɓe mun ɓen. Ko ɓen woni feddeeji hawrunooɗi e fennugol yedda ko Nulaaɓe lun addannooɓe.

versets.arabic_text: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
versets.translation: Alaa e ɗin feddeeji, mo fennaali Nulaaɓe ɓen. Lepte Allah ɗen jojji e maɓɓe, fii kala ɗe tonngino haa e dumunna.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٖ
versets.translation: Ɓee fennooɓe Muhammadu (yo o his) habbaaki, si wanaa wuttaandu ɗiɗaɓuru ndun ka alaandu, ndu alaa ruttorde. Lepte ɗen yana e maɓɓe, si ɓe ɓe tuubaali ko adii.

versets.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
versets.translation: Ɓe woni e jalkitugol wi'a: Joomi amen, yaccinan men geɓal lepte amen ɗen aduna, ado Ñalaande Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, muñño e ko fennooɓe ɓen wowlata maa kon; annditaa jeyaaɗo Amen on, Daawuuda, jom cemmbe dartorɗe ayɓe mun, muññoo e ɗoftagol Allah. Kanko ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo ruttoragol tuubannde Allah, e gollugol ko welata Mo.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
versets.translation: Men elti pelle ɗen, ko subbunhinoda e Daawuuda, ka kiikiiɗe e ka weetugol.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
versets.translation: Men elti kadi colli ɗin, ka ɗi mooɓindiraa ka weeyo, tawi ɗi fow majji, hiɗo ɗoftanii subbunhinanagol Allah.

versets.arabic_text: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
versets.translation: Men semmbiniri fii laamu Makko ngun, mirin mo Men okki mo on, wonndude e waawugol foola ayɓe makko ɓen. Men yeɗi mo Annabaaku, e hawrugol e sawaaba. Men yeɗi Mo ɗemngal laaɓungal.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, hara kabaaru wenjunooɓe ɓen ɗiɗo arii maa, tuma nde ɓe ƴawunoo ka ganngunal Annabi Daawuuda nokku dewirdo mum!

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
versets.translation: Tuma nde ɓe naatirnoo e juhal, ka Daawuuda, o ɗeƴii ɓe. Ɓe anndi o ɗenƴike, ɓe wi'ani mo: wata a hulu ! Ko men yeddondirɓe ɗiɗo; goɗɗo e amen tooñii oya. Ko yo a ñaawir nunɗal hakkunde amen, wata a tooñu, tinndinaa men e laawol focciingol ngol, woni laawol sawaaba gol.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعٞ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةٗ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
versets.translation: Gooto e maɓɓe wi'iani Daawuuda: Oo gorko, ko musiɗɗo am: himo jogii baalii cappanɗe jeenay e jeenay, min miɗo jogii baalii gootii. O ɗaɓɓiri lam henndingol mo ngil, o fooli lam e yewtere.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٞ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعٗاۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
versets.translation: Daawuuda ñaawiri hakkunde maɓɓe wi'angol wullitiiɗo on: Pellet, musiɗɗo maa on tooñirii ma, ɗaɓɓugol ɓeydiyude baalii maa ngii, ka baali makko. Ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e hawtuɓe, hino tooñindira hakkunde maɓɓe, si wanaa gomɗimɓe gollooɓe moƴƴuɗi yamiraaɗi ɗin; ɓen ɗon, ko nunɗuɓe hakkunde maɓɓe, kono ɓe ɗuuɗaa. Annabi Daawuuda felliti, wonnde Men jarriborii mo ngol wennjondiro. O ɗaɓɓiri Joomi makko haforaneede, o suuyiri sujjugol, o tuubani Allah.

versets.arabic_text: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
versets.translation: Men jaɓirani mo tuubuubuyee, yaafanagol mo ɗum. Pellet non, hino woodani ka Amen, ɓadal e moƴƴugol ruttorde laakara.

versets.arabic_text: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
versets.translation: Ko an yo Daawuuda, Men waɗii ma lomto ka hoore leydi. Siinu fiyakuuji diina e aduna ɗin, ñaawiraa nunɗal hakkunde yimɓe ɓen. Wata a jokku mbeleeɗe, tuma ñaawataa hakkunde maɓɓe, sakko tooñataa goɗɗo e maɓɓe, sabu tawde oya on no ɓaɗi maa e jeya maa e weldigal, o majjiniri ɗum, laawol Allah focciingol ngol. Anndaa, pellet, majjooɓe ɓen e ngol Allah focciingol, hino woodani ɓe lepte saɗtuɗe, sabu ko ɓe yejjitiri kon, Ñalaande hasboore nden. Tawde si ɓe annditayno fii mayre, ɓe hula nde, ɓe jokkataano mbeleeɗe.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
versets.translation: Men tagiraali kammu ngun e leydi ndin meere. Ɗum ko sikke yedduɓe ɓen. Bone Yiite woodanii ɓen yedduɓe, sikkuɓe ɗum, Ñalnde Darngal, si ɓe luttii e keeferaaku sikkitagol Allah ko boni !

versets.arabic_text: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
versets.translation: Men waɗataa ɓen gomɗimɓe Allah ɓe jokki Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe golli golle moƴƴe, wano ɓen bonnirooɓe ka leydi, geddi e keeferaaku. Men waɗataa kadi hulirɓe Joomi mun ɓen, ɗoftagol yamirooje Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko, wano heeferɓe ɓen e naafiqiiɓe yooliiɓe e geddi ɓen. Fonnugol ɓe, ko ooñaare nde yahdaa e Allah toowuɗo seniiɗo On. Si ko woni, O yoɓitiray gomɗimɓe ɓen, naatugol Aljanna, O leptira yedduɓe ɓen, naatugol Yiite. Tawde ɓe fotataa ka Allah. Njoɓdi maɓɓe kadi fotataa ka Makko.

versets.arabic_text: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكٞ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
versets.translation: Ko Deftere heewunde barki e nafa, woni ndee Alqur'aanaare, nde Men jippini e maaɗa. Fii no yimɓe ɓen taskra miijitoo maanaaji mayre, joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓen hisuɗe ɓen, waajitora.

versets.arabic_text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
versets.translation: Men yeɗi Daawuuda, geɗal makko Sulaymaana, neema e ɓural Amen, ko ɓernde makko deeƴira. Sulaymaana moƴƴii jeyaaɗo. Ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo tuubugol ruttoo e Allah.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
versets.translation: Janto nde o hollanoo kiikiiɗeere, pucci yooɗuɗi yaawuɗi, darorayɗi taape tati, ɓamta nayaɓal ngal. Ɓe seeraali e hollugol mo ɗum, haa naange muti.

versets.arabic_text: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
versets.translation: Sulaymaana maaki: Mi ɓurnorii yiɗgol jawdi, wano ɗii pucci, e dow ko mi jantotoo Joomi am kon, haa naange ngen mutoyii, mi faɗii julde alansaraa nden.

versets.arabic_text: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
versets.translation: Ruttee lam ɗii pucci. Ɓe rutti mo ɗi, o woni e sodirgol ɗi kaafa, ka taape(koyde) e ka daaɗe majji.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Men jarribike Sulaymaana, Men werii e jullere makko laamu nden, seytaniiru, nannditiniindu e neɗɗo, ndu ardii seeɗa e laamu makko ngun. Refti Sulaymaana hettiti laamu makko ngun, o wuurti mbo e seytaniiru ndun.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكٗا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدٖ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
versets.translation: Sulaymaana maaki: Joomi am, haforanam goopi am, yeɗaa lam laamu heeranii ngu lam, ngu haananaa goɗɗo goo, ɓaawo am. Ko An Joomi, woni ɗuuɗugol mawni dokke.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
versets.translation: Men jaabinani mo toraare nden. Men eltani mo henndu ndun, tawi ndu wifiray neweende, e yamiroore makko, e hoore doole e yaawere mayru fow, ndu naɓa mo ka o faalaa.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٖ وَغَوَّاصٖ
versets.translation: Men eltani mo kadi seytanuuji ɗin, ɗi woni e ley konngol makko. No e majji mahaynooɗi, goɗɗi ɗin mutaynooɗi ka maayo, ɗi yaltina kaŋŋe.

versets.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
versets.translation: Seytanuuji goo, ko rawaniyanke, eltanaaɗi mo. Ɗin ko dummbaaɗi e jolokooje, ka ɗi waawaa memminaade.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
versets.translation: Ɗum ko ko Men yeɗu maa, an Sulaymaana, ka jaabingol toraare maa. Okku mo yiɗanɗaa, maa ɗalaa mo faalaɗaa. A lamnditortaake goɗɗum e mun.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
versets.translation: Pellet, Sulaymaana ka Amen, ko jeyaaɗo e ɓadnaaɓe, maranaaɓe ruttorde moƴƴunde, woni Aljanna.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبٖ وَعَذَابٍ
versets.translation: Janto kadi, an Nulaaɗo, jeyaaɗo Amen on Ayyuuba, nde o torinoo Allah Joomi makko, wonnde: Seytaane memirii lam tampere lebtatnde.

versets.arabic_text: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدٞ وَشَرَابٞ
versets.translation: Men wi'ani mo: latir tunndawal(koyngal) maa ka leydi. O waɗi ɗum, ɓunndu ɓullitanii mo ɗon: tawi goɗɗam ɗam, ko yaretee ɗam, o lootora ɗama, ko o ittira lorra e tampere memunoonde mo nden.

versets.arabic_text: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةٗ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
versets.translation: Men jaabinani mo toraare. Men huncani mo lorra makko kan, Men yeɗi mo ɓeynguure makko nden, Men ɓeydani mo geɗalɓe e taaniraaɓe yeru maɓɓe, yurmeende immorde e Amen, e njoɓdi muñal makko ngal, e fii no joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɓen, waajitora, wonnde muñal, adday hoyeende e warjeede.

versets.arabic_text: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثٗا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرٗاۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
versets.translation: Nde Annabi Ayyuuba tikkannoo debbo makko on, o woondiri piyugol mo loyru teemedere. Men wi'ani mo ontuma : Ko an Ayyuuba, nanngiri sookewo maa ngon, tamannde huɗo, piyiraa mo ɗum, no hunniraa woodoore maa nden, hara a firtaa nden. O waɗi ɗum. Men tawu mo, ko o muññiiɗo e ko Men jarribori mo kon. O moƴƴii jeyaaɗo. Pellet, ko o ɗuuɗunooɗo tuubugol ruttoo ka Allah.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
versets.translation: Janto kadi, an Nulaaɗo, jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen ɓe Men suɓii, e Nulaaɓe Amen, ɓe Men immini: Ibraahiima, e Ishaaqa e Yaaquuba. Ɓe laatino joomiraaɓe cemmbe ka ɗoftagol Allah, ɗaɓɓa welayee Makko. Ɓe woni kadi joomiraaɓe giiɗe, jaɓooɓe goonga.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٖ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
versets.translation: Men heertinanii heertinannde, nden woni wuurnugol ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen, anntidugol fii galle laakara ɗen, hebilaronaɗe, golle moƴƴe, nodda yimɓe ɓen e mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
versets.translation: Kadi, ɓee ka Amen, ko jeyaaɓe e suɓiraaɓe ɗoftagol dewgol Men, suɓiraaɓe tammbitagol Nulal Amen ngal, yottina e yimɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
versets.translation: Janto kadi, an Annabiijo, Ismaa'iila geɗal Ibraahiima, e Ysa'u, e Zal-Kifli, mantiraaɓe mantoore labaande, tawde hiɓe hanndi e mun. Kala e maɓɓe, ko jeyaaɓe e suɓaaɓe moƴƴuɓe ɓen ka Allah.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرٞۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابٖ
versets.translation: Ɗum ko annditirgol ɓee, mantoore labaande, ka Alqur'aana. Ko pellet, hino woodani hulirɓe Allah ɓen ɗoftagol Mo woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin, ruttorde moƴƴunde, ka galle laakara.

versets.arabic_text: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
versets.translation: Nden ruttorde moƴƴunde, ko Aljannaaji ñiiɓal, ɗi ɓe naatoyta Ñalnde Darngal, hara dame majji no udditiranaaɓe, saɗnugol ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٖ كَثِيرَةٖ وَشَرَابٖ
versets.translation: Hara ko ɓe soɓɓindiiɓe e hoore danɗe cuɗinanaaɗe ɓe, hiɓe nodda gollooɓe ton ɓen, lamndooɓe muuyanteeɗi ɗuuɗuɗi serti, e noone kala e njaram, mo ɓe yiɗi, wano sanngara ekw.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
versets.translation: Hino woodani ɓe ton: rewɓe raɓɓinayɓe ndaarɗe mun e worɓe mun tun, fotɓe e duuɓi.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
versets.translation: Ko ɗum woni ko fodaɗon e njoɓdi laaɓundi, onon gomɗuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal. Fii golle mon moƴƴe ɗen aduna.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
versets.translation: Pellet, njoɓdi jantaandi fii mun ndin ɗoo, ko arsike Amen, mo Men arsikoyta gomɗuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal. Arsike duumotooɗo, mo taƴondirtaa, o lannataa.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ
versets.translation: Ko jantoo kon, ko njoɓdi gomɗuɓe ɓen. Pellet, hino woodani kadi yawtirɓe keeri Allah ɗin geddi e keeferaaku, njoɓdi sertundi; kamɓe on, ko ruttorde ɓurnde bonnde woodani ɓe Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
versets.translation: Njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin, ko Jahannama, huuɓitaynge ɓe, nge tampina ɓe nguleeki e ooyeende. Hiɓe mari ton ndaɗɗuɗe, kono ɗe bonii daɗɗuɗe!

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ
versets.translation: Ɗen lepte, ko ndiyam haɗtuɗam e fatugol, e mbor- di ilatndi e ɓalli yimɓe lepteteeɓe ɓen ka Yiite. Yo ɓe sulko ɗam, sabu ko njaram maɓɓe ɗam ittataa ɗonka ɗan non!

versets.arabic_text: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
versets.translation: Hino woodani ɓe lepte goo, nannduɗe e majje. Ɗen ko nooneeji, ɗi ɓe leptiroytee ka laakara.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا فَوۡجٞ مُّقۡتَحِمٞ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
versets.translation: Si yimɓe Yiite ɓen naatoyii e magge, ɓe ukkondi- royii hakkunde maɓɓe e weljugol hoynindira, kala e maɓɓe wona e daɗndinagol e oya. Woɗɓe e maɓɓe wi'i: E hino fedde naatidoyay nde e mon ka Yiite. Ɓe jaaboo ɓe: Toolii alanaa ɓe, tawde ko ɓe meeɗirayɓe Yiite ngen, no men meeɗirta nge.

versets.arabic_text: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
versets.translation: Fedde jokkunooɓe ɓeya ɓen wi'ana koohooɓe ɓen: ko onon ɓee koohooɓe kan, woni toolii alanaa, ko onon defi men ɗee lepte muusuɗe, sabu ko mojjinirɗon men kon, bewinɗon men. Ndee ñiiɓirde Jahannama ɗoo, nde bonii ñiiɓirde naatooɓe nge fow.

versets.arabic_text: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابٗا ضِعۡفٗا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
versets.translation: Ɓe wi'a kadi: Joomi amen, defuɗo men majjugol on, ɓaawo nde peewal ngal ari e amen, sowan mo lepte ɗen ka Yiite.

versets.arabic_text: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالٗا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
versets.translation: Bewɓe townitiiɓe ɓen wi'a: Ko haɗi men yi'ugol ka Yiite gaa, worɓe ɓe men limtaynoo ka aduna, jeyaaɓe e bomɓe, hannduɓe e lepte?

versets.arabic_text: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
versets.translation: Hara men falju e kon men jagitornoo ɓe kon jalnori, tawa ɓe handaa e lepte, kaa hara ɓe naatu Yiite, gite amen yawti ɓe?

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقّٞ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
versets.translation: Pellet, ko Men jantanii on kon, e ko yedduɓe ɓen wenjorndirta hakkunde maɓɓe Ñalnde Darngal, ko goonga mo sikke alaa e mu'un.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٞۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
versets.translation: An Muhammadu, maakan yimɓe maa yedduɓe ɓen: Anndee ko mi jertinoowo on, e lepte Allah ɗen, fii wata ɗe yanir e mon, sabu yeddugol mon fenna Nulaaɓe Makko ɓen. Anndo kadi, alaa reweteeɗo hannduɗo e dewal, si wanaa Allah Seniiɗo On. Ko Kanko woni Bajjo ka mawngu e sifaaji e ka inɗe Mun, Fooluɗo kala huunde. Mo huunde kala yankinii Ɗum.

versets.arabic_text: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
versets.translation: Ko Kanko woni Jeyɗo kammuuli ɗin, e leydi ndin, e kon ko woni hakkunde majji. Fooluɗo e laamu Mun, Mo gooto foolataa. Haforoowo junuubi jeyaaɓe Makko tuubuɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee fennooɓe : ndee Alqur'aanaare, ko kumpital mawngal fiyaaku.

versets.arabic_text: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
versets.translation: Kono hiɗon ɗuurnii e on kabaaru mawnuɗo fiyaaku. On alaa yeƴƴitaade e makko.

versets.arabic_text: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
versets.translation: Mi heɓataano ganndal, e ko feƴƴaynoo hakkunde Malaa'ika'en, fii tagugol Aadama, si wanaano Allah wahayini ɗum e am, O anndimmi.

versets.arabic_text: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
versets.translation: Allah wahayiniraali e am, si wanaa tawde ko mi jertinoowo on, e lepte Makko ɗen, ɓanninano on.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرٗا مِّن طِينٖ
versets.translation: Janto nde Joomi maa daalannoo Malaa'ika'en: Min ko Mi tagiroowo ɓanndinke, woni Aadama (yo o his) immorde e loopal.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
versets.translation: Si Mi fotindirii tagu makko ngun, Mi moƴƴintinii mbaadi makko ndin, mi wuttii ruuhu Am on e makko, ko yo on sujjan mo.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
versets.translation: Malaa'ika'en ɗoftii yamaruyee Joomi maɓɓe on, ɓe sujji ɓe denndaangal, sujuudu teddungal. Alaa mo sujjanaano Aadama e maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa Ibuliisa, o mawnitinii sujjugol ngol, o woni jeyaaɗo e yedduɓe Joomi mun.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
versets.translation: Allah daali: Ko an yo Ibuliisa, ko honɗum haɗu maa sujjangol Aadama, mo tagirmi juuɗe Am? Ko mawnintinaare haɗu maa kaa hari nun ko a jeyanooɗo e townitaniiɓe Joomi mun ɓen?

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارٖ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينٖ
versets.translation: Ibuliisa wi'i: Ko min ɓuri Aadama moƴƴude. Tawde A tagirii lam immorde e yiite, A tagirii mo kanko e loopal. Sikkugol mo wonnde yiite ɓuri loope teddude.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٞ
versets.translation: Alla daalani ibuliisa: Yaltu ka Aljanna ton, sabu ko a huɗaaɗo Kiitaaɗa.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Pellet, raɗeede ka Aljanna fawike ma, haa Ñalaande nɓjodi kuuɗe, nden woni Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
versets.translation: Ibuliisa wi'i: Nennitanam maayugol, haa ñalnde immintaa jeyaaɓe Maa ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
versets.translation: Allah daali: A jeyaama e nennitanaaɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
versets.translation: A nennitanaama, haa e happu anndaaɗo, halkeede ma.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
versets.translation: Ibuliisa wi'i: Mi woondirii kattal e mawngu Maa ngun ! Ma mi majjin ɓiɗɓe Aadama ɓen fow.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
versets.translation: Si wanaa ɓen ɓe daɗndu-Ɗaa bone am, heertinir-Ɗaa ɓe e rewugol Am tun.

versets.arabic_text: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
versets.translation: Allah daali: goonga kan ko e Am, ko goonga Mi wowlata, wanaa ko lunndi ɗum.

versets.arabic_text: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
versets.translation: Ma Mi hebbinire Jahannama Ñande Darngal, an e ɓen jokkuɓe ma, yedduɓe ɓen e banii Aadama ɓen fow.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maakan sirkooɓe ɓen: Mi lamndaaki on e ko mi yottinta e mon kon, njoɓdi. Mi wonaali kadi etotooɗo sincugol ɓeyda e ko mi yamiraa kon.

versets.arabic_text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: Alqur'aana wonaali, si wanaa waaju, wonannde hellifaaɓe yimɓe e jinna ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
versets.translation: Ma on anndu kabaaru ndee Alqur'aanaare, wonnde ko nde goonga, ɓaawo dummunna ɓadiiɗo, tuma nde maayoton.

versets.arabic_text: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
versets.translation: Jippagol Alqur'aana, ko immorde ka Allah, Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Ñeeñuɗo e tagu Mun, e toppitagol Mun e sari'a Mun. Wanaa e goɗɗo goo, ko woori Mo, nde jippori.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
versets.translation: Men jippinirii Deftere Alqur'aana nden e maaɗa, an Nulaaɗo, e hoore goonga. Kumpite mayre fow ko goonga, ñaawooje mayre fow kadi ko nunɗuɗe. Haray rewu Allah, wootinɗinaa mo, laɓɓinanaa Mo tawhiidi e hoore sirku.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبٞ كَفَّارٞ
versets.translation: Anndee, ko Allah woodani, diina laaɓuka e sirku kan. Ɓen non ɓe ɓeya jogitori yiɗɓe gaanin Allah, immorde e sanamuuji e bewinayɗi, ɗi ɓe rewata ɓe acca Allah, ɓe wona e ngantinorgol ɗum, wiide: Men rewiraali ɗii, si wanaa tun no ɓadinira men ka Allah, martaba, ɗi hewtina Mo haajuuji amen, ɗi tefana men ka Makko. Pellet, Allah ñaawoyay hakkunde gomɗimɓe wootimɓe Mo ɓen, e yedduɓe sirkuɓe ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal, e kon ko ɓe luutondiraynoo e mun, ka tawhiidi. Pellet, Allah fewnataa e goonga, on fenoowo dammba e Alla sirku, dullanoowo neemaaji Allah ɗin e makko.

versets.arabic_text: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدٗا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
versets.translation: Sinno Allah yiɗuo siforgol ɓiɗɗo, O suɓotono ko O yiɗi, e tagu Makko ngun, O waɗa on ɗon ɓiɗɗo Makko. Kono O senike O laaɓii e kon ko sirkooɓe ɓen wowolata ! Ko Kanko woni Allah Gooto On ka jaati, e ka sijaafi e ka golle Makko. Kafidiiɗo alanaa Mo e ɗin. Ko O Fooluɗo tagu Makko ngun fow.

versets.arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
versets.translation: O tagirii kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, ñenƴal yottiingal, ko fijindaaru alaa e mu'un, wano tooñuɓe ɓen aaƴorta. Himo suddira jemma on, ñalawma on, O suddira kadi ñalorma on, jemma on. O elti naange ngen e lewru ndun, tawi kala majji, hino doga haa e happu eɓɓaaɗo, on woni lannugol ɗam nguurndam. Haray anndee, ko Kanko woni Fooluɗo, yoftotoowo ayɓe Mun, Mo gooto foolataa, Haforoowo junuubi kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٖ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجٖۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقٗا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتٖ ثَلَٰثٖۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
versets.translation: Joomi mon, onon ɓee yimɓe, tagii on e fittaandu wooturu, ndun woni Aadama. Refti O tagi e makko, genndo makko on Hawaa. O tagani on gelooɗi e na'i e dammi e be'i, nooneeji jeetati, noone kala, gorel e deyel. Himo tagira on ka teege yumma mon en, sagara naɓi sagara, e nder niɓe reedu e rennga e jowtol. Ko On mooɗon tagoowo ɗum fow, woni Allah, Joomi mon. Ko Kanko laamu woodani. Reweteeɗo e goonga alaa, si wanaa Kanko. Ko honno ferlitoraɗon e rewugol ko tagataa, acca ɗon tagoowo On?

versets.arabic_text: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٞ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
versets.translation: Si onon ɓee yimɓe, on yeddii Joomi mon, anndon tun, Allah ko yondiniiɗo e gomɗinal mon, keeferaaku mon, lorrataa Mo. Ko onon ɗum lorrata, tawde Allah kan, O siforaali yamiroowo pankere e ko añinii. Si on yettii Mo non e neemaaji Makko ɗin, on gomɗinii Mo, O weltanto on, O warjoo on e ɗum. Anndon wonii bakkondinki woo, ronndantaako wokki goo. Kala e ko faggitanii hoore mun. Refti ko ka Joomi mon tun, woni ruttorde mon, Ñalnde Darngal; O yeetitoo on, fii ko gollaynoɗon aduna, O yoɓita on, njoɓdi golle mon ɗen. Kanko seniiɗo On, pellet, ko O annduɗo ko woni e ɓerɗe jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Huunde e ko woni e majje, suuɗaaki Mo.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرّٞ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادٗا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
versets.translation: Si lorra heɓii yedduɗo, wono ñawu maa sattireede arsike maa hulugol yoolaade, o toroo nde Joomi makko hunciranta mo ɗum, ruttagol e Makko, Kanko tun. Refti non, si Allah neeminirii mo huncangol mo on lorra, o yejjita fii Allah, Mo O torotonoo On, ado ɗum. O waɗana Mo kafidiiɗi, reweteeɗi, ko wanaa Allah, no o majjinira woɗɓe goo, e laawol Allah ngol. Nulaaɗo, maakan sugu on ɗon : dakmitor yeddugol maa ngol, yeru ko o heddoriɗaa e duuɓi kon. Anndaa pellet, ko a jeyaaɗo e yimɓe duumoytooɓe ka Yiite ɓen, Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدٗا وَقَآئِمٗا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
versets.translation: Kaa ko on ɗoftiiɗo Allah, feƴƴiniroowo jemma on, sujjangol Mo, darorana Mo naafe, hara himo huli lepte laakara ɗen, himo jortrii yurmeende Joomi makko nden, kaa ko yedduɗo rewoowo Allah on ka saɗteende tun, o yedda Mo ka hoyeende, o waɗana Mo kafidiiɗi? An Nulaaɗo, maaku : Hara ɓen annduɓe ko Allah farli kon e maɓɓe, hino fota e ɓen ɓe anndaa huunde e ɗum? Anndu ko taskotoo kon ko senndi ɗin feddeeji ɗiɗi, ko joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maakan jeyaaɓe Am gomɗimɓe Lam Min e Nulaaɓe Am ɓen: huliree Joomi mon, ɗoftagol yamaruyeeji Makko, e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko. Hino woodani moƴƴimɓe golle ɓen e mon aduna, moƴƴoreede e mun aduna, walleede e cellal e jawdi, ka laakara, hara ko Aljanna. Leydi Allah ndin ko yaajundi, feree e mayri, haa e nokku ka waawoton rewude Mo woo, ka goɗɗo haɗataa on ɗum. Anndon muññiiɓe ɓen, ɓe timminirante njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin Ñalnde Darngal, ko aldaa e limaneede maa etaneede, ɗuuɗi fanɗi.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: min mi yamiraama rewugol Allah tun, mi laɓɓinana Mo dewal ngal.

versets.arabic_text: وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
versets.translation: O yamirimmi kadi, wonugol arano e jebbilaniiɓe Mo ɓen, yankinaniiɓe Mo e ɗee mofte.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: min miɗo huli, si mi yeddii Allah, mi ɗoftaaki Mo, nde lepte Ñalaande Mawnde nden heɓatammi, nden woni Ñalnde Darngal.

versets.arabic_text: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maaku : min ko Allah tun mi rewata, mi laɓɓinana Mo dewal. Wanaa goɗɗo goo, mi waɗanta ɗum.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
versets.translation: Onon sirkooɓe ɓen non, rewee ko yiɗuɗon e sanamu, hara wanaa Kanko. Ɗum ko kammbaa ! An Nulaaɗo, maaku: ko woni hayruɓe ɓen tigiri, ko ɓen tawata ɓe hayrinii ko'e maɓɓe e ɓeynguureeji maɓɓe, ɓe ronkoya yiidoyde e maɓɓe, si ɓen naatoyii Aljanna, maa ɓe naatidoya e maɓɓe ka Yiite, tawa ɓe yiitidataa poomaa. Anndee ko ɗum tigiri, woni hayrere ɓanngunde nden, ko sikke alaa e mu'un.

versets.arabic_text: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلٞۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
versets.translation: Curki e kippoodi wulndi, hino woodirani ɓe senngo dow maɓɓe, e senngo ley maɓɓe. Ko ɗee lepte jantaaɗe fii mun, woni ko Allah hulɓirnirta jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen. Ko onon yo jeyaɓɓe Am, kori huliree Lam, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Am, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Am.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
versets.translation: Ɓen woɗɗitiiɓe e rewugol sanamuuji ɗin, e kala ko wonaa Allah, ɓe tuubi ɓe ruttii ka Allah, welo-welo Aljanna no woodani ɓe, tuma ɓe maayata, e ka genaale, e Ñalnde Darngal. An Nulaaɗo, wewlinir jeyaaɓe Am ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
versets.translation: Ɓen nanooɓe Konngol ɓen, ɓe senndindira ko moƴƴi e ko boni e maggol, ɓe jokka ko ɓuri moƴƴude e maggol. Ko ɓen siforiiɓe ɗin sifaaji, woni ɓe Allah fewniri peewal ɓen, ko ɓen woni joomiraaɓe haqqille hisuɗe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ
versets.translation: Kala mo konngol lepte jojjiri e mun, sabu duumagol mo e yeddugol e majjere, a alanaa on feere, an Nulaaɗo, fii no feewira. E ko an Nulaaɗo, waawata daɗndude wa'uɗo non e Yiite ngen?

versets.arabic_text: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفٞ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفٞ مَّبۡنِيَّةٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
versets.translation: Si ko ɓen hulirɓe Joomi mun, ɗoftagol yamiraaɗi Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko, hino woodani ɓe kuɓeeje toowuɗe fawondiri ka Aljanna, hara canɗi no ila senngo ley majje. Ko Allah fodi ɓe ɗum! Allah non firtataa fodoore Makko.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرّٗا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
versets.translation: Hiɗon anndiri seedagol mon, wonnde Allah saaƴinirii ndiyam ka kammu, O naadi ɗam e ɓulli e canɗ; refi O yaltinira ɗam ndiyam, remuru seedudnu noone, refti O yoorna ndu, yi'aandu an seeditiiɗo on, hindu soyɗi, ɓaawo ndu wonunoo haako; refti O waɗa ɗum ko muncitaa. Pellet, wonii e ko jantaa koo, waaju, wonannde joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓen hisuɗe ɗen.

versets.arabic_text: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٖ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
versets.translation: E ko on mo Allah yaññani ɓernde mun fii lislaamu, o feewi e mun, hara himo e ɓanngannduyee immorde ka Joomi makko, wa'ata wa yoora ɓenrdeejo e jantagol Allah? Ɓe fotataa fes. Tawde ko feewuɓe ɓen, daɗata, yoora ɓerɗe'en e jantagol Allah .Ɓen wonii e majjere ɓanngunde.

versets.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبٗا مُّتَشَٰبِهٗا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ
versets.translation: Allah jppinii e Nulaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo o his) Alqur'aana, ɓurnde moƴƴude yewtere. O waɗi nden nanndude ka goonga, e ka moƴƴugol, e ka yuɓɓondirgol e waasde luutondirde. Fillayeeji e ñaawooje hino ɗuuɗi e mayre, kañum e fodooje e kammbaa, e sifaaji yimɓe goonga, e yimɓe meere ɓen ekn. Guri ɓen hulooɓe Joomi mun, hino riɓira sabu nanugol kammbaaji ko woni e mayre, refti guri e ɓerɗe maɓɓe deeƴira jantagol Innde Allah, tuma ɓe nani jortagol e welo-welo ko woni e mayre. Koo ko jantaa e ko Alqur'aana battinta, ko peewal Allah, ngal O fewnirta mo O muuyani, O hoyna mo Mo O muuyani. Kala non mo Allah fewnaali, haray fewnoowo mo alaa.

versets.arabic_text: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
versets.translation: Kere on mo Allah fewni aduna, O naadoya mo Aljanna laakara, on fotay wa yedduɗo maayi e keeferaaku on, naatoyoowo Yiite, tonnge juuɗe e koyɗe, mo tawata waawoytaa daɗirde Yiite ngen, si wanaa tun o fewtinira nge yeeso makko ngon? Tooñuɓe ɓen feliree wi'aneede ontuma: meeɗen non hannde, kon ko wonunoɗon faggitorde geddi e keeferaaku. Ko njoɓdi mon ndin nii.

versets.arabic_text: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
versets.translation: Mofte adinooɓe ɓee sirkooɓe, kadi fennuno Nulaaɓe mun, lepte ɗen ardirani ɓe juhal, fewndo ka ɓe so'aa-anndude, sakko ɓe hebiloranaɗe tuubugol.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
versets.translation: Allah meeɗiriɓe sabu ɗum, lepte koyeera, e jaasere, e wirtere ka ngurrndam aduna. Pellet, ko lepte laakara ɗen habbitiiɗe ɓe, ɓuri mawnude e tiiɗe, si tawno hiɓe anndunoo.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
versets.translation: Gomɗii Men piyanii yimɓe ɓen, e ndee Alqur'aanaare jippinaande e Muhammadu (yo o his) noone kala e mise moƴƴere e bone, goonga e meere, gomɗinal e keeferaaku, ekn. Ɗum fow, ko jortagol nde ɓe waajitora, ɓe huutora goonga kan, ɓe sela meere nden.

versets.arabic_text: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
versets.translation: Men waɗi nde Alqur'aanaare, janngeteende e haala Aarabu, nde aldaa e ooñaare maa jiɓi-liɓi, jortagol no ɓe hulira Allah, jokkugol yamiraaɗi Makko, woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko.

versets.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
versets.translation: Allah waɗii misal hakkunde sirkoowo e wootinɗinoowo, woni gorko mo lurruɓe hawti : si o weltinii woɗɓe ɓen, ɓeya ɓen monoo, o wona e jiɓi-liɓi. Oya gorko, ko laaɓanɗo gorko goo, kanko tun, himo anndi ko deeƴinta oya, e ko wallinta mo ɓernde. Ɓen worɓe ɗiɗo, ɓe fotataa e misal. Yettoore woodanii Allah. Kono ko ɓuri ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe, ɓe anndaa. Ko waɗi si ɓe kafida e Allah, goɗɗum goo.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٞ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
versets.translation: Pelelt, an Nulaaɗo, ko a maayoowo, kamɓe kadi ko ɓe maayooɓe, feere mun alaa.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ
versets.translation: Refti onon ɓee yimɓe, Ñalnde Darngal, ko ka Joomi mon yeddondiroyton, e ko pooɗondiraynoɗon fii mun, goonguɗo on seerta e meerenteejo on.

versets.arabic_text: ۞ فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوٗى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
versets.translation: Alaa ɓurɗo tooñude haa hewta on dammbuɗo e Allah, ko yahdaani e Makko, wano waɗangol Mo kafidiiɗo, maa genndo maa ɓiɗɗo. Alaa kadi ɓurɗo tooñde wa on fennuɗo wahyu on mo Nulaaɗo Allah on (yo o his) addi. E wonaa ka Yiite woni jaaƴorde yeddude Allah ɓen, ɓe yeddi ko Nulaaɗo Makko on addi kon? Pellet, ko non woniri, weerde maɓɓe, ko nder ton.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ
versets.translation: On non arduɗo e goonga, ka haala e ka kuuɗe maɓɓe, foti ko Annabaajo maa goɗɗo goo, o gomɗini ɗum, o gollitiri. Ko ɓen woni gomɗuɓe ɓen tigiri, ɗoftiiɓe yamaruyeeji Joomi mun, woɗɗitiiɓe haɗaaɗi Makko.

versets.arabic_text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Hino woodani dakammeeji duumotooɗi, ka Joomi maɓɓe; ko ɗum woni njoɓdi moƴƴinooɓe golle ɓen, ka Joomi maɓɓe e jiyaaɓe.

versets.arabic_text: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
versets.translation: Fii no Allah momtirana ɓe, ko ɓuri bonnde e ko ɓe gollaynoo e geddi aduna, tawde ɓe tuubii e mun, ɓe ruttike e Joomi maɓɓe. O yoɓitira ɓe njoɓdi maɓɓe ndin, ko ɓuri moƴƴude e kon ko ɓe gollunoo.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
versets.translation: Mbela Allah siforaali yonugol jeyaaɗo Makko on Muhammadu (yo o his) ka fiyakuuji makko diina e aduna, O duñana mo ayɓe makko? Pellet, O yonay mo. Hiɓe hulɓinire, an Nulaaɗo, sabu majjere e ɗaayre maɓɓe, ɗin sanamuuji, ɗi ɓe rewata ɓe acca Allah, wiide ɗi memirte bone. Kala non mo Allah hoyni, O hawrinaani mo fewnude, haray fewnoowo on ɗon, alaa.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ
versets.translation: Kala non mo Allah hawrindini e peewal, alaa haɗtanɗo majjinde mo. Mbela Allah siforaaki wonnde Fooluɗo Mo gooto foolataa, Jom leptugol ɓen heefereɓe yedduɓe Mo? Ko non woniri, Ko O Fooluɗo, Jom lepte.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
versets.translation: Pellet, si an Nulaaɗo, a lamndike ɓee sirkooɓe: Ko hommbo tagi kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin? Ma ɓe wi'u: Ko Allah tagi ɗi. Awa maakan ɓe, feññinanaaɓe, ronkere reweteeɗi maɓɓe ɗin: Yeetee lam fii ɗii sanamuuji, ɗi rewoton gaanin Allah; si Allah faandanike lorra, hara ɗi waaway ittannde lam on lorra? Maa si O faandanike lam moƴƴere Makko, taw si ɗi haɗtani haɗugol lam nden moƴƴere Makko? Maakan ɓee: Allah tun yonii lam, ko e Makko mi fawi kala fiyaaku am, ko e Makko kadi tun, woni ko wakkiltoo ɓen tuuginotoo.

versets.arabic_text: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلٞۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
versets.translation: An Nulaaɗo, maaku: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, golliree no waalorani on, sirkangol Allah. Min ko no Joomi am yamirimmi non, mi gollirta, woni noddugol e tawhiidi, laɓɓinana Mo dewal. Aray ka anndon, battane laawol kala e me'en.

versets.arabic_text: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
versets.translation: Aray nde anndon, ko hommbo lepte aduna hoynayɗe aroyta e muuɗum, lepte duumiiɗe jippoyoo e makko Ñalnde Darngal, hara ɗe taƴondirtaa, sakko ɗe lanna.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
versets.translation: Men jippinirii Deftere Alqur'aana nden, e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, fii yimɓe ɓen, e hoore goonga, no jertiniraaɓe. Kala feewuɗo, ko hoore makko o feewani, Allah nafitortaa peewal makko, tawde ko O yondiniiɗo e ɗum; kala kadi majjuɗo, haray lorra mun on, ko e makko yiltotoo, ɗum lorrataa Allah. A wonaali wakkilaaɗo ɓee, fii daranagol ɓe haa ɓe feewa. Ko yottingol tun, fawi maa e maɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
versets.translation: Allah hino ƴettita pittaali ɗin, tuma lajal majji timmata, e ɗin ɗi lajal mun timmaali, fewndo ɗoyngol majji. O jogitii ɗin ɗi O ñaawani maayde, O accita ɗiya, ɗi O ñaawani heddagol, haa e dumunna happaaɗo ka Makko. Pellet, wonii e ko sifaa koo, maandeeji, wonannde ɓe miijitotooɓe, tinndinayɗi, wonnde waɗoowo ɗum On, hino hattani wuurnitugol yimɓe ɓen, ɓaawo maayde maɓɓe, fii hasbugol ɓe, yoɓa ɓe.
