versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndin Ma-aan nelaaɗo-ko woni ñalngu ceerndugol.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e lepte e perte e oon ñalawma woodanii fennuɓe ko nelaaɓe ngaddi ummaade ka Alla.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نُهۡلِكِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
versets.translation: Mbela Min kalkaana leƴƴi gadinooɗi nde njedduno penni Nulaaɓe mum en?.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ نُتۡبِعُهُمُ ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
versets.translation: Refti Min bndewna heen cakkatiiɓe ɓe, Min kalkaɓe no Min kalkiri mon nih.

versets.arabic_text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
versets.translation: Ko hono no Min kalkiri ɗiin leƴƴi, Min kalkirta fennuɓe ko Nelaaɗo addi ko.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e lepte woodanii wonande ɓeen fennooɓe njbdi mum en ñande ñalngu njoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَخۡلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ
versets.translation: Mbela Min tagaani mon- onon aade en-ummaade e ndiyam kouɗam ko ɗaam woni toɓɓere maniyyu.

versets.arabic_text: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ فِي قَرَارٖ مَّكِينٍ
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi ndiyam ɗam e nokku deenaaɗo ko oon woni rannga debba.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
versets.translation: Haa e dumunna ganndaaɗo ko oon woni yonto caawgol suko.

versets.arabic_text: فَقَدَرۡنَا فَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡقَٰدِرُونَ
versets.translation: Min koddiri sifa jibinaaɗo o mbaadi makko e ko nanndi heen, heskey Oon koddirɗo ɗuum fof Minen.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e lepte e perte woodanii wonande ɓeen fennooɓe baawal Alla.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ كِفَاتًا
versets.translation: Mbela Min mbaɗaani leydi ndi na sooma aade en fof.

versets.arabic_text: أَحۡيَآءٗ وَأَمۡوَٰتٗا
versets.translation: Hondi renndini wonɓe heen wuurɓe e maayɓe ubbaaɓe e hendi .

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi e hendi pelle tabitɗe, na ndeena ndi e dillude toowɗe, Min njarndi mon ndiyam mbelɗam, tagɗo ɗuum horataaka umminde mon.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e lepte woodanii wonande ɓeen fennooɓe njoɓdi mum en ñande ñalngu jnobdi.

versets.arabic_text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
versets.translation: Wiyanee fennooɓe ko nelaaɓe ngaddi ko- onon fennoobe- kuuƴe faade ko pennatnaɗon ko e lepte.

versets.arabic_text: ٱنطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلّٖ ذِي ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٖ
versets.translation: Njahee faade e mbeelu cuurki yiit mbanndi cate tate.

versets.arabic_text: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
versets.translation: Ɓuuɓol ɗowdi alah toon, ndi haɗatah lew lewndu yiite e nguli mum yande e mon.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهَا تَرۡمِي بِشَرَرٖ كَٱلۡقَصۡرِ
versets.translation: Yiite nge na werlo peete, kala heen wootere Alla no mawniri a sikkat ko huɓeere.

versets.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٞ صُفۡرٞ
versets.translation: Peete werleteeɗe Alla noɗe ɓalwiri e noɗe mawniri a sikkat koɗe geloobi ɓaleeji.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare woodanii wonande ɓeen fennooɓe njoɓdi mum en ñande ñalngu jnobdi.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
versets.translation: E o ñalngu ɓe kaalatah hay huunde.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَا يُؤۡذَنُ لَهُمۡ فَيَعۡتَذِرُونَ
versets.translation: Ɓe cakkitantaake sabu ɓe ngantina faade e joom mum en ko faati e keefeeru e bone mum en, ɓe ɗaɓɓira Mbo ngantu.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e perte woodanii ɓeen fennooɓe kabaruuji ñalngu jnobdi.

versets.arabic_text: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِۖ جَمَعۡنَٰكُمۡ وَٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
versets.translation: O ko ñalngu ceerndugol hakkunde tagaaɗe, Min ndenndinii on e leƴƴi gadiiɗi e dingiral gootal.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمۡ كَيۡدٞ فَكِيدُونِ
versets.translation: Si tawii hoɗon ndañi feere nde puuntiraton haa ndaɗon e lepte Alla pewjanee lan.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare woodanii wonande ɓeen fennooɓe njoɓdi mum en ñande ñalngu jnoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلٖ وَعُيُونٖ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓeen reentiriiɓe joom mum siinude jamirooje Alla e reentaade kaɗe Makko, hoɓe e nder ɗowdi lekɗe aljanna e ceewle ndiyam belɗe ilooje.

versets.arabic_text: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
versets.translation: E ɓesnaaɗe ɗeɓe tuuyate ñaamde.

versets.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
versets.translation: Ɓe wi*anee:ñaame e laaɓɗi, njaron njaram mbelɗam ɗam alah lorla, sabu ko golle mon moƴƴe ka aduna.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
versets.translation: Yeru ndi njoɓdi ndi Min njoɓi mon, ko hono ndi Min njoɓirta labinɓe golle mum en.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e lepte e perte woodanii ɓeen fennooɓe ko Alla heblani hulɓe e jnoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجۡرِمُونَ
versets.translation: Fennuɓe ɓe na wiyee:ñaame ndakmitaɗon e wela wela nguurndam tuma setta ka aduna, ko on bonɓe sabu ko pennuɗon ko Alla e nelaaɓe Makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare woodanii wonande ɓeen fennooɓe njoɓdi mum en ñande ñalngu jnoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرۡكَعُواْ لَا يَرۡكَعُونَ
versets.translation: Si ɓee fennooɓe mbiyaama: njuule ngam Alla ɓe njuulatah.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e lepte e perte e oon ñalawma woodanii fennuɓe ko nelaaɓe ngaddi ko ummaade ka Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَهُۥ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
versets.translation: Siɓe goonɗinaani oo Quraana tellinaaɗo ummaade ka Alla honde yeewtere woɗnde ɓe goonɗinta?.

versets.arabic_text: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
versets.translation: Ko ɓee sirkuɓe naamnandirta caggal de Alla neli e mum en nelaaɗo Makko-yo o his-

versets.arabic_text: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
versets.translation: Hoɓe naamnandira kabaaru mawɗo on, oon woni Quraana tedduɗo tellinaaɗo e nelaaɗo mum en coomɗo kabaaru ummital.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي هُمۡ فِيهِ مُخۡتَلِفُونَ
versets.translation: O Quraana mbo ɓe luuri e mum e koɓe cifatoo mbo ko, wonde kombo mbilewu wolla jime wollo wageyaagal wolla tinndi adiiɓe.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
versets.translation: Wonah noɓe ngaaƴarii nih, ɓee fennuɓe qurana maɓe nganndu batte pennugol maɓɓe bonngol.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعۡلَمُونَ
versets.translation: Refti teentana ɓe ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَلِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مِهَٰدٗا
versets.translation: Mbela Min mbattaani leydi ndi keblaandi wonande ɓe, lobbundi ngam ñiiɓal mum en.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَوۡتَادٗا
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi pelle ɗe penɗe na haɗa leydi ndi dimmbaade.

versets.arabic_text: وَخَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا
versets.translation: Min tagi on onon yimɓe nooneeli: worɓe e rewɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا نَوۡمَكُمۡ سُبَاتٗا
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi ɗoyngol mon taƴaade gah e golle ngam pooftaɗon.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسٗا
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi jemma o ko cuuroowo on hono niɓe jemma mbo cuurdaton awraali mon.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشٗا
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi ñalawma o lefu faggitaade e yiilaade arsuka.

versets.arabic_text: وَبَنَيۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعٗا شِدَادٗا
versets.translation: Min mahi dow mon kammuuli jeeɗiɗi cattuɗi mahnga ñeeñuɗi gollal.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَعَلۡنَا سِرَاجٗا وَهَّاجٗا
versets.translation: Min mbaɗi naange nge lampu cattuɗa kuɓɓam e njalbeendi.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمُعۡصِرَٰتِ مَآءٗ ثَجَّاجٗا
versets.translation: Min tellini ummaade e duule potɗe toɓde ndiyam njuppajam sanne.

versets.arabic_text: لِّنُخۡرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبّٗا وَنَبَاتٗا
versets.translation: Ngam Min yaltina heen noone gabbe, e noone puɗi.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا
versets.translation: Min njaltina heen gese pilandirɗe leɓɗɗ ngam naatandirde cate mum.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتٗا
versets.translation: Pellet, ñalawma ceerndugol hakkunde tagaaɗe laatiima ko ka dotta e waktu mbo luutndataako.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا
versets.translation: Ñande Malayka o wutti e allaadu he wuttannde ɗimmere, ngaron-onon yimɓe- pelle pelle.

versets.arabic_text: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا
versets.translation: Kammu on uddite mbo wonta hono dame udditaaɗe.

versets.arabic_text: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ فَكَانَتۡ سَرَابًا
versets.translation: Pelle ɗe mbaɗaa jahooje haa ɗe ngonti punndi nduuyndi, ɗe mba*i hono merere.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتۡ مِرۡصَادٗا
versets.translation: Pellet yiite jahannama nge wontii tommbii nge.

versets.arabic_text: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابٗا
versets.translation: Nge wonanii bewɓe ɓe ruttorde kaɓe nduttato.

versets.arabic_text: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحۡقَابٗا
versets.translation: ɓe ñiiɓa toon yontaaji ɗi ngalah happu.

versets.arabic_text: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا
versets.translation: ɓe meeɗatah toon henndu ɓuuɓndu ustooru nguli Sa*iir, wonah ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam kono dakmitire.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا حَمِيمٗا وَغَسَّاقٗا
versets.translation: ɓe meeɗatah si wonah ndiyam ngulɗam jaw, e ƴiiƴiiri ciiwatoondi e yimɓe yiite.

versets.arabic_text: جَزَآءٗ وِفَاقًا
versets.translation: Njobdi yaadundi e koɓe wonno ko e dow mum ummaade e keefeeru e majjere.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا
versets.translation: Pellet ɓe e aduna ɓe kulaano haasboore Alla ka laakira, sabu ɓe ngoonɗinaani ummital, siɓe ngoonɗinna ummital ɓe ngoonɗinatna Alla, ɓe golla ko moƴƴi.

versets.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابٗا
versets.translation: ɓe penni aayeeje Amen tellinaaɗe e Nelaaɗo Amen pennugol.

versets.arabic_text: وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ كِتَٰبٗا
versets.translation: Kala huunde e golle mum en Min tonnggiɗe Min limi, tawa na winnda e ɗeri golle mum en.

versets.arabic_text: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
versets.translation: Meeɗe -onon bewbe- ɗee lepte duumiiɗe, Min ɓeydantah on si wonah lepte e dow lepte mon.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
versets.translation: Pellet na woodani hulirɓe Alla siinude ko O yamiri e accude ko O haɗi, nokkere malal nde mbo ɓe ndañata faalee mum en ko ɗuum woni aljanna.

versets.arabic_text: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا
versets.translation: Gese e inabeeje.

versets.arabic_text: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتۡرَابٗا
versets.translation: E ƴoolnuɓe fotɓe duuɓi.

versets.arabic_text: وَكَأۡسٗا دِهَاقٗا
versets.translation: E kaas dolo keewɗo.

versets.arabic_text: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّٰبٗا
versets.translation: Ɓe nanatah ka aljanna haala meere, wolla fenaande, ɓe penandirtah.

versets.arabic_text: جَزَآءٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابٗا
versets.translation: ɗum fof ko dokke Alla jonɗe.

versets.arabic_text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
versets.translation: jom kummuuli e leydi e ko woni hakkunde mum en, jurmotooɗo aduna e laakara, denndaangal ko woni e kammu e leydi ngalah hakke naamnaade Mbo si wonah O sakkitan ɓe ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
versets.translation: Ñande jibriil ummii tawa malayka en na waɗi saffeeli, ɓe haalatah e tefande hay gooto si wonah mbo jurmotooɗo sakkitani tefoore, o haala ko feewi, ko ɗuum woni konngol tawhiid.

versets.arabic_text: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
versets.translation: ɗuum ko cifanaɗon woni ñalngu mbo alah sikke gargol mammba, mbo faala daɗde e lepte Alla yo o nanngir laawol golle lobbe ɗe Alla welete faade heen.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
versets.translation: Min njeertanii on-onon aade en- lepte ɓadiiɗe yande, ñande aade ndaari ko gollunoo ko ka aduna, keefeero o wiya ngam wooɗeede iwde e lepte: haaniina mi wonta leydi hono no kulle ɗe nih, saanga nde ɗe mbiyate: ngontee leydi.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا
versets.translation: Alla woondiri malayka en pooɗooji pittaali heeferɓe pooɗgol cattungol.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشۡطٗا
versets.translation: Alla woondarii malayka en ittatɗi pittaali goonɗinɓe e mbaadii newiindi.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبۡحٗا
versets.translation: Alla woondarii malayka en lummbatooɗi ummaade kammu faade leydi e yamiroore Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبۡقٗا
versets.translation: E Alla woondarii malayka en gadandiratɗi gadandirgol fii siinude yamiroore Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱلۡمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمۡرٗا
versets.translation: Alla woondarii kadi malayka en ciinooji ko Alla yamiri e ñaawoore Mum hono malayka en wakkilaaɓe golle jiyaaɓe, O woondarii ɗum fof wonde ma O umminɓe O haasba ɓe O yoɓa ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
versets.translation: ñande leydi ndi ndimmbii saanga wuttaango adano.

versets.arabic_text: تَتۡبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
versets.translation: Rewa e nduu wuttaandu wuttaandu ɗimmuru.

versets.arabic_text: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ
versets.translation: ɓerɗe heefereeɓe e faasigeeɓe ñande heen na kuli.

versets.arabic_text: أَبۡصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٞ
versets.translation: Na feeña e gite mum en batte koyeere.

versets.arabic_text: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرۡدُودُونَ فِي ٱلۡحَافِرَةِ
versets.translation: Hoɓe mbiyatnoo: Mbela min nduttoto e nguurndam caggal min maayi.

versets.arabic_text: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمٗا نَّخِرَةٗ
versets.translation: Mbela si min ngontii ƴi*e dappuɗe min nduttoto no min ngonruno nih.

versets.arabic_text: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ
versets.translation: ɓe mbi*a: si min nduttiima, ngool duttagol wona duttagol pertungol, joom mum wona puuntaaɗo.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
versets.translation: Fiyaaku ummital na newii, ɗuum ko wuttaango wooto ummaade e malayka bakkilaaɗo wuttude.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
versets.translation: Ndeke tan denndaangal wuurɓe e dow leydi caggal ndeɓe ngonnoo maayɓe e nder reedu mayri.

versets.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Mbela arii e Ma-aan nelaaɗo- kabaaru Muusa wondude e joom Makko e wondude e gaño makko fir*awna.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
versets.translation: Tuma nde joom makko ceniiɗo O noddimbo ka caatngol Tuwa laɓɓinangol.

versets.arabic_text: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
versets.translation: O maakini mbo e ko maaki: yahu ka fir*awna o yawtarii keerol tooñde e mawnikinaare.

versets.arabic_text: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
versets.translation: Maakan mbo: Mbela woodanaani ma-aan fir*awna- nde laaɓataa e keefeeru e goopi.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ
versets.translation: Mi feewnu ma faade e joom ma Oon takɗo ma O reen ma kulaa Mbo, ngollaa ko welata Mbo, ndeenaɗa ko mettata Mbo.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Muusa holli mbo maande mawnde nde holliroonde wonde ko O nelaaɗo ummaade e joom makko, ko ndeen woni junngo ngo e sawru ndu.

versets.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
versets.translation: Fir*awna alah ko waɗi si wonah fennude nde maande, o woopi ko joom makko yamiri ko Muusa-yo o his-.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ
versets.translation: Refti o ɗuurnii goonɗinde ko Muusa addi ko o tiiɗnii e woopde Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
versets.translation: O renndini yimɓe makko e sukkuɓe e makko ngam foolandirde e Muusa o noddi o wii:

versets.arabic_text: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
versets.translation: Miin woni joom mon ɓurɗo toowde, ɗoftaare woonanaani mbo wonah miin e dow mon.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Alla nanngi mbo O leptiri mbo e aduna yoolaade e maaya, O leptiri mbo laakara naatnude mbo e lepte cattuɗe sanne.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Wonii e halkude fir*awna aduna e laakara waaju wonande kulɗo Alla, ko oon naftorto waajuuji.

versets.arabic_text: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Mbela ko woodnude mon-onon fennuɓe ummital- ɓuri sattude wolla ko woodnude kammu mbo mahi o ɓuri sattude.

versets.arabic_text: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
versets.translation: O waɗi mbildi mammbo ko toowndi, O waɗi mbo potondirɗo, mbo alah petti wolla ayiiba.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَغۡطَشَ لَيۡلَهَا وَأَخۡرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
versets.translation: O niɓɓaɗini jemma makko si naange mutii, O feññini annoore makko si naange fuɗii.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
versets.translation: E leydi caggal nde O tagi kammu O werti ndi, O waɗi e mayri nafooje mayri.

versets.arabic_text: أَخۡرَجَ مِنۡهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرۡعَىٰهَا
versets.translation: O yaltini e mayri ndiyam ceewle ilooje, O fuɗni heen puɗi ngam durngol kulle.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
versets.translation: E pelle ɗe O laatin ɗe tabitɗe e dow leydi.

versets.arabic_text: مَتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
versets.translation: ɗum fof ko nafooje mon-onon aade en- e daabe mon, O tagɗo ɗum fof ronkatah ruttude ɗum e laawol goɗngol.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Si wuttaango ɗimma ngo arii ngo huurdi kala huunde e kulhuli, darngo darii.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
versets.translation: ñalawma mbo ari aade siftoro ko o golluno, foti ko ko lobbi wollo ko boni.

versets.arabic_text: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
versets.translation: jahannama adde ɓannginane wonande yi*oowo.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon palguɗo keerol e nder majjere.

versets.arabic_text: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
versets.translation: O ɓurni nguurndam aduna ngasajam e dow nguurndam laakara keddoto ɗam.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
versets.translation: Pellet ko yiite woni ñiiɓirde makko nde o hoɗata.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon kuldo daraade e yeeso joom makko, o haɗi fittaandu sukkude e belaaɗe e ko Alla harmini ko aljanna woni galle makko.ɗƴñƴñ

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon kulɗo daraade e yeeso joom makko, o haɗi fittaandu sukkude e belaaɗe e ko Alla harmini ko aljanna woni galle makko.

versets.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Na naamna ma-aan nelaaɗo-fennooɓe ummital ndey darnga darato.

versets.arabic_text: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكۡرَىٰهَآ
versets.translation: Woodanaani Ma ganndala daragol darnga saka kaalanaa ɓe ɗum, te ɗum wonah ko mah, wonan ma ko heblanaade ɗum.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
versets.translation: Ko e joom ma gooto tan woni haaɗtirde ganndal darnga.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Ngonɗaa tan ko jeertinoowo kulɗo darnga, sabu ko oon woni naftoroowo jeertingol Ma.

versets.arabic_text: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Elle ñande ɓe ceedii darnga, ɓe ñiiɓaani si wonah kikiiɗa yel e nguurndam mum en aduna wolla subaka yel gootel.

versets.arabic_text: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
versets.translation: O ñirɓanii o runtii.

versets.arabic_text: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ
versets.translation: Sabu arde Abdullaay Ibnu ummu Maktuum hombo ɗaɓɓa peewal,ko o gumɗo o wonnoo,o ari tawi nelaaɗo na sokliri mawɓe sirkuɓe ngam O feewnaɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndin Ma-aan nelaaɗo- yaama oo gumɗo laaɓa e bakkatuuli makko.

versets.arabic_text: أَوۡ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Wollo o waajito ko o nanata ko e ma e waajuuli o naftaroo ɗi.

versets.arabic_text: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon jonaaɗo hoore makko ngalu makko o acci iimaan e ko ngadduɗa ko.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
versets.translation: Aan haɗa faloo mbo haɗa hucca e makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا عَلَيۡكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
versets.translation: Hol ko heftoto Ma si o laaɓiraani e bakkatuuji makko ruttaade e Alla.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسۡعَىٰ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon gaɗo e ma hombo yaha ngam yiilaade moƴƴere.

versets.arabic_text: وَهُوَ يَخۡشَىٰ
versets.translation: Hombo huli Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَنتَ عَنۡهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
versets.translation: Aan noon haɗa sokliri mawɓe heeferɓe gaa e makko.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ
versets.translation: Wonah noon huunde nde wa*i, huunde nde kay ko teskuya wonande jaɓoowo.

versets.arabic_text: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
versets.translation: Kala faalaado jantoo mbo, o waajitoroo ko woni ko e Quraana.

versets.arabic_text: فِي صُحُفٖ مُّكَرَّمَةٖ
versets.translation: Oo quraana mbo woni ko e ɗereeli teddinaaɗi ka malayka en.

versets.arabic_text: مَّرۡفُوعَةٖ مُّطَهَّرَةِۭ
versets.translation: ɓamtaaɗo toownaaɗo; ceniiɗo mbo soɓe mematah.

versets.arabic_text: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ
versets.translation: Hombo e juuɗe malayka en nulaaɓe.

versets.arabic_text: كِرَامِۭ بَرَرَةٖ
versets.translation: Tedduɓe ka Alla, heewɓe golle lobbe.

versets.arabic_text: قُتِلَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكۡفَرَهُۥ
versets.translation: Huɗaama aade alah ko ɓuri mbo sattu keefeeru.

versets.arabic_text: مِنۡ أَيِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
versets.translation: E honde huunde Alla tagiri mbo haa o mawnikinii e dow leydi o yeddi Mbo?.

versets.arabic_text: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
versets.translation: E ndiyam setta O tagri mbo, O waɗi tagu makka taaɓe taaɓe.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
versets.translation: Refti O newnani mbo caggal ɗee taaɓe laawol no o yaltiri e reedu neene makko.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُۥ
versets.translation: Refti caggal nde O hoddirani mbo wuurde e nguurndam O wari mbo, O waɗani mbo e yenaande o heddoo heen haa ummital.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
versets.translation: Refti si O faalaama O ummitina mbo ngam haasbeede e yoɓeede.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقۡضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
versets.translation: Wonah noon huunde nde keefeero o sikki wa*i hono wonde o tottii ko Alla haandi ko e dpow makko e hakkeeli, alah o tottiraani ko o fawaa ko e farillaaji.

versets.arabic_text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
versets.translation: Yo aade keefeero o ndaar ñaamdu makko ndu o ñaamata hono o heɓri ndu.

versets.arabic_text: أَنَّا صَبَبۡنَا ٱلۡمَآءَ صَبّٗا
versets.translation: Woni asli mum ko ndiyam telliɗam ummaade e kammu e mbaadi keewndi.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ شَقَقۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ شَقّٗا
versets.translation: Refti Min pettini leydi ndi, ndi yaltini puɗi.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا حَبّٗا
versets.translation: Min puɗni heen gabbe hono makkaari e bele e ka nanndi heen.

versets.arabic_text: وَعِنَبٗا وَقَضۡبٗا
versets.translation: Min puɗni e hendi inabu e huɗo ngam jaɓnde daabe.

versets.arabic_text: وَزَيۡتُونٗا وَنَخۡلٗا
versets.translation: Min puɗni e hendi oliv e tamara.

versets.arabic_text: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا
versets.translation: Min puɗni e hendi gese keewɗe leɗɗe.

versets.arabic_text: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا
versets.translation: Min puɗni e hendi muuyanteele e ko daabe ndurata.

versets.arabic_text: مَّتَٰعٗا لَّكُمۡ وَلِأَنۡعَٰمِكُمۡ
versets.translation: Ngam wona nafoore mon e nafoore daabe mon.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
versets.translation: Si haacaango manngo cukkoowo noppi ko ngoon woni ɗimmo ngo arii.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ
versets.translation: ñande aade dogi musiɗɗo makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
versets.translation: O doga neene makko e baaba.

versets.arabic_text: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
versets.translation: O doga cuddiiɗo makko e ɓiɓɓe makko.

versets.arabic_text: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ
versets.translation: Kala gooto e mum en na sokliri ko o woni ko e dow mum ummaade satteende suna oon ñalngu.

versets.arabic_text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ
versets.translation: Geece malaabe ñande heen pooyni.

versets.arabic_text: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ
versets.translation: Hoɗe njala hoɗe mbeltii.

versets.arabic_text: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ
versets.translation: Geece hiitaaɓe e oon nyalngu ina e dow mum sollaaru.

versets.arabic_text: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
versets.translation: Na hippaɗe niwre.

versets.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
versets.translation: Sifariiɓe ɗii sifaali ngoni renndinɓe keefeeru caay saagal.

versets.arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si kammu renndinaama annoore mum yahi.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si koode caami ndaaygu mum momtii.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si pelle ndillinaama ittaa nokkuuli mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ
versets.translation: Si naagaaji coowɗi ɗi jom mum en pompandiratno mbelsindaama ɗi ngacca.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si kulle ladde ndenndinaama e aade en e nokku gooto.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si maaje kuɓɓaama haa ngonti yiite.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ
versets.translation: Si pittaali cinndindiraama e ko ɗi nanndi, hulndu Alla cinndindire e hulndu Alla, saay saayeeru cinndindire e saay saayeeru.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ
versets.translation: Si Alla naamniima deyel ubbanangel na wuuri.

versets.arabic_text: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ
versets.translation: Hol bakkaat wardi ngel barɗa ngel o.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si ɗeri golle jeyaaɓe caaktaama, haa gooto fof jannga ɗerewol mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ
versets.translation: Si kammu o huttaama hono no dammuwol huttirte nih.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si yiite huɓɓaama.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ
versets.translation: Si aljanna ɓallinaama hulɓe Alla ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si ko haala ko fof arii fittaandu annda kondu tawni e golle nder oon ñalawma.

versets.arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ
versets.translation: Mbeɗa woondira koode birniiɗe ko addi ndeɗe pudata saanga jemma.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ
versets.translation: Dogooje e falakuuli mum wirnatooɗe saanga subaka ari hono lelli naatɗi e koɗrɗe mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
versets.translation: Mi woondarii arwannde jemma si mbo arii e arde, e si mbo arii e runtaade.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
versets.translation: O woondiri subaka si annoore mum arii.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ
versets.translation: Pellet quraana telliiɗo e Muhamadu-yo o his-ko haala Alla ko malayka koolaaɗo yottini mbo, oon woni jibriil-yo o his- mbo Alla hoolii.

versets.arabic_text: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
versets.translation: jom semmbe jom daraja ka jam arsi Ceniiɗo.

versets.arabic_text: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ
versets.translation: Na ɗoftii mba ɓe kammu, koolaaɗo ko O yottinta ko e wahyu.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ
versets.translation: Muhamadu-yo o his- gondiijo mon mbo ngannduɗon hakkille makko e hoolaare mum e goonɗude mum wonah kaangaaɗo hono noɓe pepindorto nih.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
versets.translation: Gondiijo mon yi*ii jibriil e mbaadi tagu mbo o tagiraa o ka jookli kammu laaɓtuɗo on.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ
versets.translation: Gondiijo mon O wonah ɗawoowo nde O yottinta on ko O yamiraa ko yo O yottin, O nanngatah njoɓdi hono no wageeɓe nih.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ
versets.translation: O auraana wonah haala seytaan diiwaaɗo ummaade e yurmeende Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ
versets.translation: Hongol laawol naataton haa njeddon wonde Quraana ko ka Alla mbo ummii caggal ɗii dallillaaji?

versets.arabic_text: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: O auraana mbo wonah si wonah waaju wonande yimɓe e jinneeji.

versets.arabic_text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
versets.translation: Kala e mon faalaaɗo fooccaade e laawol goongo.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: On faaletaake fooccaade wolla goɗɗum goo si wonah Alla haaje ɗuum jom binnde On.

versets.arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si kammu on fettii sabi tellaade Malayka en e mammba.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si koode ɗe njanii ɗe carii.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si maaje ɗe udditiraama ɗe njillandiri.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ
versets.translation: Si genaale ɗe leydi mum waylaama sabu ummitaade maaynooɓe wonnooɓe heen.

versets.arabic_text: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
versets.translation: Oon ntuma kala fittaandu annda kondu ardinno e golle e kondu leelnuno tawa ndu gollaana ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
versets.translation: Eehey ma neɗɗanke keefeero;holko taki haɗa lunndoo joom ma tuma nde O muñan ma O yaawnaaki leptude ma e teddungal Makko?

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
versets.translation: Oon gootnuɗo ma caggal nde a wonaani, O waɗ ma fotandirɗo terɗe poocciiɗ.

versets.arabic_text: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
versets.translation: E kala mbaadi ndi O faalaa O takru ma, O neemanii ma sabu O waɗaani ma e mbaadi mbabba wollo waandu maa rawaandu wollo goɗɗum.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Huunde nde wonah no mbaadanirɗon nih-onon hoomtaaɓe- ko woni ko, ko on yeddooɓe ñalngu njoɓdi on ngollantaa mbo.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
versets.translation: Na woodi e dow mon, malaykaaji deenooji golle mon.

versets.arabic_text: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ
versets.translation: Tedduɗi ka Alla, binnddoji golle mon.

versets.arabic_text: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
versets.translation: Gannduɗi ko ngolloton e golle ɗi mbinndaɗe.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓeen heewa golle lobbe e ɗoftaare ina e neema duumiiɗo ñande darnga.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓe faajiraagal ina e yiite huɓɓatnde e dow mum en.

versets.arabic_text: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Hoɓe naatange ñande ñalngu njoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
versets.translation: ɓe ngonah wirnatooɓe yiite nge haa bada, ko woni kay ko toon ɓe caasata.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndin Ma-aan nelaaɗo-ñalngu njoɓñdi.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Refti hol ko anndin Ma ñalngu njoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
versets.translation: ñalngu ngu hay gooto waawah nafde hay gooto, huunde fof ko Alla woodani ñande heen, O firlitoo hono no O faalara, goɗɗo wo alah.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e perte ngoodanii ustooɓe peese.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
versets.translation: ɓeen peesanteeɓe ummaade woɓɓe ɓe ɗaɓɓa timminaneede hakke mum en timmuɗo ko aldah e ustaare.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ
versets.translation: Siɓe ɓetanii aade en wolla ɓe peesani ɓe, ɓe usta, ko nih yimɓe Madiina ngonruno saanga fergo Nelaaɗo-yo o his- faade e mum en.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ
versets.translation: E ɓe golloobe ɗe pankare pellitaani wonde maɓe ummitine faade e Alla?.

versets.arabic_text: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
versets.translation: Na woodani haasboore e njobdi ñalngu teddungu ngam ko woni ko heen e musibbaaji e kul huli.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
versets.translation: ñande yimbe ummanii jom tago fof ngam haasbeede.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
versets.translation: Huunde nde wonah no mbaadanirɗon nih wa*i wonde ummital alah caggal maayde, ko woni ko deftere faajireeɓe nani ka to ɓuri leesɗude ka leydi.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndin Ma-aan nelaaɗo-hol ko woni sijjiin?.

versets.arabic_text: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
versets.translation: Pellet deftere mum en ko winndaande, nde uytetaake nde ɓeydetaake.

versets.arabic_text: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
versets.translation: Halkaare e perte woodanii e oon ɗo ñalngu fennuɓe ɓen.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: ɓeen fennooɓe ñalaande njobdi nde, nde Alla yoɓata heen jiyaaɓe makko golle mum en ka aduna.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
versets.translation: Fennatah oon ɗo ñalngu si wonah palguɗo keerol, keewdo bakkaat.

versets.arabic_text: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
versets.translation: Si aayeeje amen tellinaaɗe e nelaaɗo Amen janngaama e mum, o wi*a: Ko tinndi leƴƴi gadiidi, wonah ko ummii ka Alla.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
versets.translation: Huunde nde wonah no fennooɓe mbaadaniri nih, kono muuri ɓerɗe maɓɓe koɓe paggatii ko e goopi, ɓe nji*iraani goongo ɓerɗe mum en.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
versets.translation: Ko goongo kamɓe de koɓe haɗaaɓe yiide joomi mum en ñande darnga.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
versets.translation: Refti kamɓe koɓe naatooɓe yiite, ɓe tampa e nguli henge.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
versets.translation: Refti ɓe wi*e ñande darnga sekndorde ɓe: ɗe lepte kawruɗon ɗe de woni ko pennatna ɗon ka aduna nde nelaaɗo habri on.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
versets.translation: Huunde nde wonah no,mbaadinirɗon nih wonde haasboore e njoɓdi ngaratah, deftere ɗoftiiɓe nani ka Illiyiina ko toon woni to martaba ɓurɗo toowde.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndin Ma-aan nelaaɗo-hol ko woni Illiyyiina?.

versets.arabic_text: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
versets.translation: Pellet deftere mum en ko winndaande, nde uytetaake nde ɓeydetaake.

versets.arabic_text: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
versets.translation: Ina seedoo nde deftere ɓadiiɓe kala kammu ummaade e malayka en.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓeen heewa golle lobbe e ɗoftaare ina e neema duumiiɗo ñande darnga.

versets.arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
versets.translation: E dow leece cuɗaaɗe koɓe ndaarooɓe faade e joom mum en, e kala ko welnata pittaalimum en.

versets.arabic_text: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
versets.translation: Si a yi*iiɓe nji*a e geece mum en batte neema ngam lobbere e yooɗde.

versets.arabic_text: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ
versets.translation: Na yarnaɓe liggatooɓe mum en dola mbo mbaɗirkon mum omndaa.

versets.arabic_text: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
versets.translation: Balangol misku na uura haa e haaɗtirde mum, e ndii njoɓdi teddundu yo daɗandirooɓe daɗandir heen, tawa ko e gollude ko welata Alla, e accude ko tikkinta Mbo.

versets.arabic_text: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ
versets.translation: Njaram ɗam na jille e seewnde Tasniim.

versets.arabic_text: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
versets.translation: Ndeen ko seewnde ɓurnde toowde ka aljanna laaɓde pos, denndaangal goonɗinɓe na njara heen.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
versets.translation: ɓeen faajirinɓe sabu koɓe ngonnoo e keefeeru, hoɓe njalatnoo goonɗiɓe ngam jalkitde ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
versets.translation: Siɓe mbirtiima goonɗiɓe ɓe ngona e ɓiiñandirde ngam jalkitde e saboote.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
versets.translation: Siɓe nduttiima ka koreeji mum en ɓe ndutto koɓe weltorɓe koɓe ngoni ko e keefeeru e sabootde goonɗinɓe ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
versets.translation: Siɓe ceediima juulɓe, ɓe mbi*a: pellet ɓee ko majjuɓe gaa e laawol peewal, sabu accude ɓe diine baabiraaɓe mum en.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
versets.translation: Alla wakkilaani ɓe reende golle mum en haa ɓe kaala haala mum en ko.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
versets.translation: ñande darnga goonɗinɓe Alla njala heeferɓe hono noɓe njaldatnooɓe ka aduna.

versets.arabic_text: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
versets.translation: E leece cuɗaaɗe hoɓe ndaara ko Alla heblani ɓe e neema duumiiɗo.

versets.arabic_text: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
versets.translation: Ko goongo yoɓraama heeferbe golle mum en ɗebe ngollatno ka aduna lepte koynooje.

versets.arabic_text: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
versets.translation: Si kammu on fettii sabi tellaade Malayka en e mammba.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
versets.translation: Mbo heɗii joomi makko wondude ɗoftaare, woodani mbo hakke e ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
versets.translation: Si Alla fooɗti leydi ndi hono no nguru fooɗtirte nih.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
versets.translation: Ndi werlii ko woni e mum e ngaluuji e maayɓe, ndi acciti gaa mum en.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
versets.translation: Mbo heɗii joomi makko wondude ɗoftaare, woodani mbo e hakke kadi woodanii Mbo e ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
versets.translation: Eehey ma aade, ko a golloowo jam wolla bone, ko a pottoowo e joom ma ñande darnga ngam O yoɓ ma golle ma.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon tottiraaɗo ɗerawol golle mum junnga ñaama.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا
versets.translation: Yaama o haasbe haasbeere newiinde o holle golle mum ko aldah e nanngiteede.

versets.arabic_text: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا
versets.translation: O ruttoo e koreeji makko ko p beltiiɗo.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon tottiraaɗo deftere mum nana makko ummorde caggal keeci makko.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا
versets.translation: Ma o noddu halkaare e dow hoore makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
versets.translation: O naata yiite jahannama o suma e nguleeki mum.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
versets.translation: Pellet o woniina beltiiɗo e nder koreeji makko sabu ko o wonnoo ko e heefeeru e goopi.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
versets.translation: Pellet o sikkiina o ruttataaka e nguurndam caggal maayde.

versets.arabic_text: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
versets.translation: Oho kay, ma Alla ruttu mbo e nguurndam hono no tagirnoo mbo adanum nih, Alla noon na sutii alhaali makko hay ndiga wirnataako Mbo, ma O yoɓ mbo golle makko.

versets.arabic_text: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii mboɗeeri koode saanga mutal naange e jookli.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
versets.translation: O woondiri jemma e kombo soomi.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
versets.translation: O woondirii lewru si ndu timmii.

versets.arabic_text: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ
versets.translation: Ma on pawandire e mbaadi tagu e alhaali caggal alhaali ummaade e toɓɓere refti heɗɗere refti husre refti heen nguurndam caggal maayde.

versets.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
versets.translation: Hol ko haɗi heefereeɓe goonɗinde Alla, e ñalngu cakkatiiɗo.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
versets.translation: Si Quraana janngaama e mum en ɓe cujjatah.

versets.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
versets.translation: Woni ko ɓeen heefereeɓe ɓe pennat ko nelaaɓe mum ngaddani ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
versets.translation: Ko Alla anndi ko wirnii e ɓerɗe mum en, hay huunde wirnataako Mbo e golle mum en.

versets.arabic_text: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
versets.translation: Habruɓe-aan nelaaɗo- ko fadiɓe e leɓte muusɗe.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
versets.translation: Si wonah ɓeen gomɗimɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe golli moƴƴuɗi yamiraaɗi ɗin, hino woodani ɓe njoɓdi duumotoondi ndi taƴatah, woni Aljanna.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii kammu coomɗo tolndeeji naange e lewru e ko nanndi heen.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
versets.translation: O woodirii ñalngu darnga mbo O fodi nde O renndinta tagoore nde.

versets.arabic_text: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ
versets.translation: O woondiri kala ceediiɗo hono Annabi seedorto e leñol mum, e kala ko seeda hono no leñol seedororto e Annabi mum.

versets.arabic_text: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ
versets.translation: Hulaama ɓeen fettinɓe leydi petti mawɗi.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ
versets.translation: ɓe kuɓɓi yiite, ɓe mberlii heen goonɗinɓe tawi hoɓe nguuri.

versets.arabic_text: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ
versets.translation: Tuma nde ɓe njooɗi e ngool pettol kebbinangol yiite.

versets.arabic_text: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
versets.translation: Kamɓe koɓe mbaɗata ko goonɗinɓe ɓe e lepte e muusnude koɓe seediiɓe, sabu taweede ɓe ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
versets.translation: Heefereɓe ngaybinaani goonɗiɓe ɓe si wonah ɓe ngoonɗinii Alla poolɗo Mbo gooto foolatah, jettaaɗo.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
versets.translation: Ko kanko gooto tan woodani laamu kammuuli e leydi, ko O kumpatiiɗo kala huunde, hay huunde suuɗataa ko Mbo e fiyakuuji jiyaaɓe Makko.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
versets.translation: ɓeen leptirɓe juulɓe worɓe e juulɓe rewɓe yiite ngam ruttaɓe gaa e goonɗinde Alla gooto O, refti ɓe tuubaani bakkatuuji mum en, woodaniiɓe ñande darnga lepte jahannama, woodaniiɓe lepte yiite sumoowe ɓe honge sumaɓe, sabu njoɓdi koɓe cumrunoo goonɗiɓe yiite.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓeen goonɗinɓe Alla, ngolli ko lobbi, woodaniiɓe Aljannaaji na ila ley kuɓeeje e ledde mum caatli, ngam njoɓdi ndi Alla heblani ɓe, ndiin woni malal manngal, ngal malal waawah ɓadaade.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
versets.translation: Pellet nanngannde joom ma-aan tooñɗo- hay si O muñanii ma- konde sattunde.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
versets.translation: Ko Kanko fuɗɗata tagu e lepte, O ruttaɗe.

versets.arabic_text: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ
versets.translation: Ko Kanko woni Yaafatooɗo tuubɗo e jiyaaɓe Makko, Hombo yiɗi waliyaaɓe Makko hulɓe Mbo.

versets.arabic_text: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
versets.translation: jom arsi tedduɗo.

versets.arabic_text: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
versets.translation: Baɗoowo ko O haaja e yaafaade bakkaatji, e leptude mbo O welaa hay gooto waawnataa Mbo.

versets.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ
versets.translation: Mbela arii e maa-aan nelaado- yeewtere konuuli ngam habtaade goongo e falaade mbo?.

versets.arabic_text: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ
versets.translation: Fir*awna e Samuud gondiiɗo Saalihu.

versets.arabic_text: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ
versets.translation: Haɗaani ɓe gooɗinde waasde arde e mum en kabaruuji leƴƴi pennuɗi e halkeede ɗi, kono tan koɓe fennooɓe ko ari ko e mum en ummaade e nelaaɓe sabu rewde delaaɗe mum en.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ
versets.translation: Alla huɓindii golle mum en hay huunde faatataako Mbo heen, te ma O yoɓɓe.

versets.arabic_text: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانٞ مَّجِيدٞ
versets.translation: Quraana wonah yimre hono no fennooɓe mbiirata, kammba ko mbo Quraana tedduɗo.

versets.arabic_text: فِي لَوۡحٖ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ
versets.translation: Hombo e alluwal deenangal e wayleede maa usteede wolla ɓeydeede.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii kammu e hoodere fuɗoore jemma.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndin Ma -aan nelaado- ko woni fiyaaku hoodere mawnde nde?

versets.arabic_text: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
versets.translation: Konde hoodere yuliroore kammu njalbeeri mayre.

versets.arabic_text: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
versets.translation: Alah fittaandu si wonah Alla na wakkili e mayru malayka ndeenoowo golle mayru ngam hasboore ñande darnga.

versets.arabic_text: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
versets.translation: Yo aade ndaartina ko e hoɗum Alla tagri mbo, haa laaɓana mbo kattane Alla e ronkere aade.

versets.arabic_text: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٖ دَافِقٖ
versets.translation: Alla tagirii mbo e ndiyam njuppoto ɗam e rannga.

versets.arabic_text: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
versets.translation: ɗam ndiyam na yalta hakkunde noorol keeci gorko e ƴi*e ɓernde debbo.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ
versets.translation: Alla ceniiɗo o -nde O tagi mbo e ndiyam koyɗam-na hattani ummindede mbo caggal maayde ngam hasboore e njoɓdi.

versets.arabic_text: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
versets.translation: ñande cuuɗiiɗi kuncaa, ko wonno e ɓerɗe e anniyaaji e piɓle njaltina, ko laba seera ko boni.

versets.arabic_text: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
versets.translation: Woodanaani aade e oon ñalawma cemmbe duñooje lepte Alla wonah balloowo.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii kammu ngu toɓo, sabu hongo tellaro toon laawol caggal laawol.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii leydi ndi petti ɗi puɗi e ɓeynaaɗe e leɗɗe njaltata.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٞ فَصۡلٞ
versets.translation: Pellet o Quraana telliiɗo e muhamadu komb konngol ceerndawol hakkunde goonga e meere e hakkunde goongo e fenaande.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ
versets.translation: Mbo wonah fijirde e meere, kammbo ko mbo soobe e goongo.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗا
versets.translation: Pellet fennuɓe ɓe hoɓe pewja peeje keewɗe ngam ɓe ndutta noddaandu makko ndu, ɓe mbonna ndu.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدٗا
versets.translation: Miin mi fewja feere sabu ɓannginde diine e ittude meere.

versets.arabic_text: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا
versets.translation: Muñan -aan nelaaɗo- ɓee heefereeɓe muñagol setta, wota heñana leptugol ɓe e halkude ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى
versets.translation: Senin Innde joom ma gonɗo dow tagu Makko, ngowla Innde Makko mawninaa Mbo.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
versets.translation: Oon takɗo aade hombo foti, hombo fooccii darnde.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
versets.translation: Oon koddiranɗo tagooje leƴƴi mum e noone mum e sifaaji mum, O feewni kala ko taga e ko yaadi e mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ
versets.translation: Oon yaltinɗo e leydi durngol daabeeje mon.

versets.arabic_text: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ
versets.translation: O watti ngol yoorngol guuringol e ɓaleeri caggal nde ngol woni keccol.

versets.arabic_text: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Ma Min janngin Ma-aan nelaado- quraana, Min ndenndina mbo e ɓernde Ma A yejjittaa mbo abadan, woto adandir e jibriil e janngude mbo hono no mbaɗratnaɗa ko adii ngam reerɗude waasde yejjitde.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
versets.translation: Si wonah ko Alla faala yo A yejjit ngam ñeeñal, Alla ceniiɗo O na anndi ko ɓanngi e ko wirnii hay ndiga wirnataako Mbo e ɗuum.

versets.arabic_text: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Min newnan Ma golle belooje Alla naatnooje aljanna.

versets.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Waaja aade en ko Min mbahyi Ma e quraana, siftinir ɓe ɗo waaju nafata.

versets.arabic_text: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ
versets.translation: Ma waacta e waaju Ma oon kulɗo Alla, sabu ko oon naftorto waaju.

versets.arabic_text: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
versets.translation: Na woɗɗito waaju o, o doga mbo oon keefeero, sabu ko kanko ɓuri hiiteede ka laakara ngam naatde mbo yiite.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Oon naatoowo yiite mannge nge o tampa e nguleeki henge haa pooma.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
versets.translation: Refti o saasnee e yiite o maayatah o foofto e lepte, o wuuratah nguurndam mbelɗam tedduɗam.

versets.arabic_text: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
versets.translation: Malaama oon laaɓɗo e sirku e goopi.

versets.arabic_text: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
versets.translation: O jantii ko sariyina e jikru, o tottiri juulde e mbaadi yamiraandi ndi.

versets.arabic_text: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
versets.translation: Kono hoɗon ngardina nguurndam aduna e dow nguurndal laakira wondude noɗe mba*i seertude nih.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Na woodani laakara ɓural e dow aduna sabu ko woni ko laakara e dakkamme duumiiɗo e neema mbo taƴandirtah haa pooma.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
versets.translation: Ko Min haalani on ko e jamirooje e kabaruuji ina e ɗereeji gadiiɗi tellaade ko adii.

versets.arabic_text: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
versets.translation: ɗiin ngoni tellinaaɗi e Ibraahiima e Muusa yo kisal won e mum en.

versets.arabic_text: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ
versets.translation: Mbela arii e Ma-aan nelaaɗo-yeewtere ñalngu darngo muuratngu aade e kuli huli mammba?

versets.arabic_text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
versets.translation: Aade en e ñande darnga ko hiitaaɓe wolla malaaɓe, tawi ko hiitaaɓe Geece mum en na koyi na yankanii.

versets.arabic_text: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ
versets.translation: Hoɗe tampiri callale ɗeɓe ndaasirte, e tonngi tonngiraaɗi.

versets.arabic_text: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ
versets.translation: ɗeen geece na naata yiite wulnge ɓe tampaira nguleeki ki.

versets.arabic_text: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ
versets.translation: Hombo yarnee e seewnde nde ndiyam mum satti nguleeki.

versets.arabic_text: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
versets.translation: ɓe ngalah ñaamdu si wonah darii, ɗum ko ñaamdu ɓurndu bonde e luuɓde e puɗi soɗi njoori ɗi tookete.

versets.arabic_text: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
versets.translation: ɗi nafatah ñaamoowo ɗi ittatah heege.

versets.arabic_text: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ
versets.translation: Geece malaaɓe e oon ñalawma na neemi na njalbi, sabu neema.

versets.arabic_text: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ
versets.translation: Golle mum lobbe ɗe ɓe ngolli e aduna na mbela, sabu heɓde njobdi golle mum moftanooɗe na cowa.

versets.arabic_text: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ
versets.translation: E nder Aljanna toowuɗo nokku e darja.

versets.arabic_text: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ
versets.translation: A nanatah e aljanna haala meere e bolle puuyɗe, wonah noon nande ko harmi.

versets.arabic_text: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ
versets.translation: Ina e aljanna he ceewle ilooje, ɓe firlitoo heen noɓe welara.

versets.arabic_text: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ
versets.translation: Ina e hembo leece ɓamtaaɗe.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ
versets.translation: E kaasaaji na kebla ngam yardeede.

versets.arabic_text: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ
versets.translation: Ina e hembo ngaflaaje pawandiraaɗe yogo e dow yogo.

versets.arabic_text: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ
versets.translation: Ina e hembo mbettule buy na werta kala nokku.

versets.arabic_text: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
versets.translation: Mbele ɓe ndaaraani ndaarannde teskagol no Alla tagiri ngelooba O eeltaniba aade?

versets.arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ
versets.translation: ɓe ndaara kammu hono mbo ɓamtira haa mbo wonti mbildi ndeenaandi, mbo yanatah e dow mum en.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ
versets.translation: ɓe ndaara pelle hono ɗe ɓamtira ɗe tabitini leydi haa ndi waasa dimmbaade e dow aade en.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
versets.translation: ɓe ndaara leydi ndi hono ndi wertira, ndi heblana yimɓe ngam ɓe koɗa heen.

versets.arabic_text: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ
versets.translation: Aan nelaaɗo waaja ɓe, kulɓinaaɓe lepte Alla, aan ko a baajatooɗo, ɗaɓɓaaka e ma si wonah siftinde, hono kawraangal e iimaan ko junngo Alla woni.

versets.arabic_text: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
versets.translation: A wonah pawaaɗo e mum en haa mbaawnaaɓe goonɗinde.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
versets.translation: Kono oon duntiiɗo iimaan, o yeddi Alla e Nelaaɓe Makko.

versets.arabic_text: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ
versets.translation: Alla lepta mbo ñande darnga lepte ɓurɗe mawnude ɗuum woni naatde yiite o saasa toon haa pooma.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
versets.translation: Pellet ko e Amen woni ruttorde maɓɓe caggal maayde.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
versets.translation: Refti ko Amen tan woni ko golle mum kaasbate, wonah e goɗɗo goo.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ
versets.translation: Alla ceniiɗo O woondarii wenndoogo.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii jemmaaji sappa battandiiɗi e lewri jil hijjati.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ
versets.translation: Mi woondiri ko ɗimmita e ko teelɗi e geɗe goodaaɗe.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ
versets.translation: Mi woondiri jemma si mbo arii; mbo ɓenni mbo runtii, ma on njoɓe golle mon.

versets.arabic_text: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
versets.translation: Mbela ina ndee woondoore ko jaɓnata jom hakkille?

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
versets.translation: Mbela A yi*aani-aan nelaado- no Alla waɗi Aad en yimɓe Huud nde ɓe penni nelaaɓe?

versets.arabic_text: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ
versets.translation: Leñol Aad ummingol e taani mum en Iram jom darnde.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
versets.translation: Mbo hono mum tagaaka e dow leydi.

versets.arabic_text: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
versets.translation: Mbela A yi*aani no joom Ma waɗi Samuud yimɓe Saalihu, ɓeen seekɓe pelle, ɓe mbaɗi ɗe cuujɗi.

versets.arabic_text: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
versets.translation: Mbela A yi*aani hono joom ma waɗi Fir*awna oon jom penɗe ɗe o leptiratno yimɓe.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
versets.translation: ɓee fof mbewiina njawti keeri e canndallaagal e tooñnnge, gooto e mum fof yawtiino keerol e leydi mum.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ
versets.translation: ɓe kebbini e hendi bonannde sabu ko ɓe caakti toon ko e keefeeru e goopi.

versets.arabic_text: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
versets.translation: Alla meeɗniɓe lepte cattuɗe, O ɗoofiɓe e dow leydi.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
versets.translation: joom Ma-aan nelaado- na tommbii golle mum en na ndaara ɗe, ngam yoɓde oon moƴƴinɗo aljanna, oon bonnuɗo yoɓee yiite.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
versets.translation: Tawi ko aade na e neesu mum si joom makko jaribiimo mbo O teddini mbo; O neeminiri mbo ngalu e ɓesngu e koongu, o sikka wonde ɗuum ko teddungal ka Alla, o wiya:joom am teddinii kam sabu mina haandi e teddungal Makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
versets.translation: Si tawii O jaribiimo mbo O faaɗni arsuko makko, o sikka ɗuum ko koyeere makko to joom mum, o wiya:joom am hoynii kam.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
versets.translation: Alah wonah no aade mbaadinta wonde neemineede ko daliilu weluya Alla wonande maccuɗo mum, e wonde satteende ko maande koyeere to joomiraawo, ko woodi ko woni on teddintaana baaya e arsuko Alla okki mon o.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
versets.translation: O hirjindirtah ñamminde baasɗo mbo alah nguura.

versets.arabic_text: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا
versets.translation: Hoɗon ñaama hakkeeli lohɓe rewɓe e yatimeeɓe ñaamgol cattungol ko aldah e reentaade na dagii wolla dagaaki.

versets.arabic_text: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا
versets.translation: Hoɗon njiɗi jawdi sanne, lomon nafkude ndi e laawol Alla sabu reerɗude e hendi.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
versets.translation: Haanaani nde golle mon wa*ata nih, ciftare si leydi ndi dimmbaam dimmbere sattunde ndi yirbi.

versets.arabic_text: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا
versets.translation: joom ma ara-aan nelaado- ngam ñaawde hakkunde jiyaaɓe; malaykaaji ɗi ngara na mbaɗi saffeeji.

versets.arabic_text: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: E oon ñalawma jahannama addee hombo waɗi 70000 ujunere ginol, kala heen gootol na e mum 70000 wuluure malayka na ndasa mbo, ndeen noon aade siftoro ko o welsandino, kono ko siftorde nafata oon ñalawma, o ñalngu ko mbo njoɓdi wonah mbo golle.

versets.arabic_text: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي
versets.translation: O wi*a sabu sattude nimsa: Haaniino mi ardina golle lobbe wonande nguurndam am ka laakara, ko ɗaam woni goongo.

versets.arabic_text: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
versets.translation: E oon ñalawma hay gooto leptatah yeru lepte Alla, sabu ko lepte Alla ɓuri sattude e duumaade.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
versets.translation: Hay gooto tonngotaake e callallale hono tonngi heeferɓe e nder henge.

versets.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ
versets.translation: Tawi ko fittaandu goonɗinɗo ndu wi*anee saanga maayde e ñande darnga: Eehey ma fittaandu deeƴndu faade e iimaan e golle lobbe:

versets.arabic_text: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ
versets.translation: Ruuto e joom ma hombo wela ma, anne haɗa welaa Mbo sabu ko ndaɗa ko e baraaje mawɗe sabu golle ma lobbe.

versets.arabic_text: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي
versets.translation: Naat e maccuɓe Am moƴƴuɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
versets.translation: Naatdu e mum en aljanna Am mbo keblanmi ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii e leydi kormaandi ndi ndiin woni Makka.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
versets.translation: E Aan- nelaaɗo-na dagani Ma ko mbaɗɗa e ndii leydi, hono warde potɗo wareede, e dahde potɗo daheede.

versets.arabic_text: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ
versets.translation: Alla woondiri baaba mum aade en, o woondiri kadi ko yalti e ɓiɓɓe mum.

versets.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ
versets.translation: Ko goongo Min tagii aade e tampere, o hawra e tamperaaji aduna.

versets.arabic_text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
versets.translation: Mbela aade sikku si o waɗii goopi hay gooto waawah e mum hay huunde, hay si ko Alla tagɗo mbo o.

versets.arabic_text: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا
versets.translation: O wiya: Mi nafkii jawdi keewndi pawandirndi.

versets.arabic_text: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
versets.translation: Mbela o basorotooɗo ko o tottiri ko Alla yi*aani mbo? te alah kaasboowo mbo, holto o dañi kaake mum ɗe.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ
versets.translation: Mbela Min mbaɗanaani mbo gite ɗe o yiirata.

versets.arabic_text: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ
versets.translation: E ɗemngal e toni ɗiɗi hombo yeewtira mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
versets.translation: Min nganndini mbo laawol jam e laawol meere.

versets.arabic_text: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ
versets.translation: Ko o ɗaɓɓiraaɗo falgude palal keetngal mbo e aljanna o taƴa ngal o yawta ngal.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ
versets.translation: Hol ko anndi Ma-aan nelaaɗo-palal ngal o foti taaɓaade ngam o naata aljanna.

versets.arabic_text: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
versets.translation: Ngaal palal woni rimɗinde daande gorko maa debbo.

versets.arabic_text: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
versets.translation: Nde o ñamminta e ñalngu ngu newaaki heɓde ñaamde.

versets.arabic_text: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ
versets.translation: Suka yatiime baaba, jiidaaɗo ko ɓadi.

versets.arabic_text: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ
versets.translation: Wollo baasɗo mbo alah hay ndiga.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
versets.translation: Refti o laati e ɓeen goonɗiɓe Alla, yogo e mum en wasiyii yogo muñal e ɗoftaade e goopi e musibbaaji, ɓe mbasandiri yurmondirde.

versets.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
versets.translation: Ko ɓeen sifariiɓe ɗiin sifaaji ngoni joman en ñaaame.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
versets.translation: ɓeen yedduɓe aayeeje Amen tellinaaɗe e nelaaɓe Amen, ɓeen ngoni joman nane.

versets.arabic_text: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
versets.translation: Ina e dow mum en yiite uddaange ñande darnga ɓe lepte e henge.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Alla woondirii naange e waktu ɓamtaraade nge ka fuɗirde mannge.,

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
versets.translation: O woondiri lewru sondu rewii batte henge caggal mutal.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
versets.translation: O woondiri ñalawma sombo hunciima e dow yeeso leydi e njalbeendi hembo.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Mi woondiri jemma si mbo muuri laral leydi, ndi wonta niɓɓundi.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
versets.translation: O woondiri kammu, O woondiri mahngo mammbo haralla.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
versets.translation: O woondiri leydi, O woondiri mbertu mayri, ngam aade en koɗa heen.

versets.arabic_text: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
versets.translation: O woondiri kala fittaandu, O woondiri tagde Alla ndu fittaandu fotondirndu.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
versets.translation: O fammini ndu ko aldah e jannginde ko boni ndu deesto, e ko laba ndu waɗa.

versets.arabic_text: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
versets.translation: Malaama oon laɓɓinɗo fittaandu mum o suɗi ndu e ɓure, o ittindu e ko boni.

versets.arabic_text: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
versets.translation: Pertii tigi oon loowɗo fittaandu makko e goopi e bakkatuuji.

versets.arabic_text: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ
versets.translation: Samuud en pennii annabi mum en Saalih sabu yawtude ɓe keerol e waɗde goopi e bakkatuuji.

versets.arabic_text: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا
versets.translation: Tumo nde ɓurɗo hiiteede e mum en ummii caggal neleede mbo ummaade e yimɓe mum en.

versets.arabic_text: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
versets.translation: Nelaaɗo mum en Saalih maakani ɓe: Accee naaga Alla,e yarde ba ñalawma mabba wotee memnee ba bonannde.

versets.arabic_text: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
versets.translation: ɓe penni nelaaɓe mum en ko faati e ngelooba he, ɓurɗo o hiiteede wari ba e weleedeɓe, ɓe ndenndi bakkaat, Alla ommbi e mum en lepte Makko, O halkari ɓe haacaanga sabu bakkatuui mum en, O fotndi ɓe lepte ɗe O halkari ɓe.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا
versets.translation: Alla waɗi e mum en lepte kalkuɗe ɓe, te O hulaani kanko Ceniiɗo O battane mum.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii e jemma si mbo muurdii hakkunde kammu e leydi e niwre mammbo.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
versets.translation: O woondirii ñalawma si mba hunciima mbo ɓanngi.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
versets.translation: O woondirii ko O tagi ko nooneeji ɗiɗi gorel e deyel.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
versets.translation: Pellet golle mon-onon yimɓe- na ceerti, na heen lobbe naatnooje aljanna; e bonɗe na wona sabaabu naatde yiite.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
versets.translation: Kala tottirɗo ko fawii mbo hono askal e nafaqe e kaffaara, o reenti ko Alla haɗi.

versets.arabic_text: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
versets.translation: O goonɗini ko Alla fodani mbo e lomtaari.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Ma Min newnan mbo golle lobbe, e nafqude e laawol Alla.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
versets.translation: Tawi ko oon gammbuɗo ngalu makko o tottiraani mbo to haani, o yondinii e jawdi makko gaa e Alla o naamnaaki Alla e ɓural Makko hay huunde.

versets.arabic_text: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
versets.translation: O fenni ko Alla fodi ko e wostaneede e baraaje ko nafqi ko jawdi mum e laawol Alla.

versets.arabic_text: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
versets.translation: Ma Min newnan mbo golle bonɗe, Min cattinana mbo gollude ko laba.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
versets.translation: Nafataa mbo jawdi ndi o ɗawi hay huunde , si o naatii yiite.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
versets.translation: Ko e Amen fawi seerndude laawol goongo e meere.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
versets.translation: Woodanii Amen nguurndam laakara e nguurndam aduna, Min pirlitoo heen no Min mbelara, alah mbo ɗum woodani si wonah Minen.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ
versets.translation: Njeertin Mi on yiite huɓɓoowe si on ngoopi Alla.

versets.arabic_text: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
versets.translation: Yanngataaka e nguli ngee yiite si wonah ɓurɗo hiiteede oon woni keefeero.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
versets.translation: Oon pennuɗo ko nelaaɗo-yo o his- addi ko, o ɗuurnii gollirde yamiroore Alla.

versets.arabic_text: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى
versets.translation: Ma woɗɗitonge ɓurdo hulde Alla oon woni Abuu bakri yo welu Alla won e makko.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
versets.translation: Oon nafqoowo jawdi mum e geece moƴƴere ngam o laaɓa e bakkatiiji.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Tottirtah tottiroowo e jawdi mum ngam o yoɓa neema mbo goɗɗo neemini e dow makko.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
versets.translation: Alah ko o faala ko o tottirta ko e jawdi makko si wonah Yeeso Toowɗo e dow tagu Makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
versets.translation: Yaama o wele ko Alla tottata mbo e njobdi teddundi.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii arwannde ñalawma.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii jemma si mbo niɓɓiɗi dille aade en deeƴi.

versets.arabic_text: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
versets.translation: joom Ma -aan nelaaɗo- accaani Ma, O tikkanaani ma, hono no sirkuɓe mbi*irata nde wahyu darii setta.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
versets.translation: Ko gelle laakar ɓuri galle aduna, sabu ko mbo soomi ko e neemaaji duumiiɗi ɗi taƴandirtah.

versets.arabic_text: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Yaama joom ma okku ma baraaje aan e leñol ma haa mbeleɗa ko O okku ma ko.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
versets.translation: O tawii ma ko a yatiime mbo baaba mum sankii, O tottuma moolorde, Taane Abdul Muttalibi neh ma ko noon kadi Bappa ma Abuu Taalib.

versets.arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ
versets.translation: O tawma a anndah binndol e iimaan, O anndin ma heen ko a anndaana.

versets.arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلٗا فَأَغۡنَىٰ
versets.translation: O taw ma ko a baasɗo O alɗin ma.

versets.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
versets.translation: Woto bonnu gollodde e alyatiima baasɗo baaba makko saanga cukaagu, woto hoynu mbo.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ
versets.translation: Woto furo ñaagatooɗo katajinɗo.

versets.arabic_text: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ
versets.translation: Yettu neema mbo joom ma neemin ma kaala mbo.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ
versets.translation: Alla yaacnii ɓernde ma O yiɗnu ma jaɓɓaade wahyu.

versets.arabic_text: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ
versets.translation: Min njaafi ma ko yawti ko e bakkatuuji ma Min tellinan ma teddeendi balɗe jaahiliyya ɗe ngonnaɗa ɗe.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ
versets.translation: Oon tampinɗo ma haa keeci ɗesi helde.

versets.arabic_text: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ
versets.translation: Mi toownan ma jantawol ma, haa mbattuɗa inneede e noddinaandu e wuurnaandu e ka nanndi heen.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
versets.translation: Sattaande ɓittere fof woni battane mum ko newuya e yaajeende e ittude nde.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا
versets.translation: Kala satteende e ɓittere na wondi e newaare e yaajeende, si a anndii ɗuum hulnataa ma wollo faloo noddaandu ma lorde yimɓe ma wollo falaade noddaandu Ma.

versets.arabic_text: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ
versets.translation: Si gaynii golle ma, kantinɗaa ɗe tiiɗna e dewal Alla.

versets.arabic_text: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب
versets.translation: Waɗ ndeereeru Ma e faandaare Ma faade e Alla gooto O.

versets.arabic_text: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii Tiin e ɗoki fuɗi, e jeytuun e ɗoki fuɗi to leydi Palastiin ka Iisa -yo o his- nelanoo to.

versets.arabic_text: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii Fella Tuur ka Siina to Alla haalduno e Muusa-yo o his-.

versets.arabic_text: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ
versets.translation: Alla woondirii Makka leydi kormaandi ndi naat ɗo heen fof dañata hoolaare, ka Muhamadu-yo o his- nelaa to.

versets.arabic_text: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
versets.translation: Miin ngoodnii aade e tagu e mbaadi ɓurndi labeede e fooccaade.

versets.arabic_text: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
versets.translation: Refti Min ndutti mbo e nayewu e naakgol ka aduna, o naftortah ɓanndu makko, ko noon kadi o naftortah si o bonnii neesu makko o wattini e yiite.

versets.arabic_text: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
versets.translation: Si wonah ɓeen goonɗinɓe ngolli golle lobbe, ɓeen haysi ɓe naywii na woodani ɓe baraaje duumiiɗe ɗe ta ƴandirtah, ko ndiin woni aljanna, sabu ɓe laɓɓanii neesu mum en.

versets.arabic_text: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
versets.translation: Hol huunde roondu ma -aan aade- haa pennuɗa ñalawma njobdi caggal seedaade maande kattane Alla keewɗe.

versets.arabic_text: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
versets.translation: Mbela Alla wonah-ko O waɗi ko ñalngu dargo kombo njobdi- ko kanko ɓuri nuunɗude e ñaawooɓe? Mbela na yaadi hakkille nde O acca jiyaaɓe Makko ko dudooɓe ko aldah ñaaweede hakkunde mum en, o yoɓa mo moƴƴinɗo golle mum, bonnuɗo yoɓe ko boni.

versets.arabic_text: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ
versets.translation: janngu-aan nelaaɗo- ko Alla wahyi ma ko, udditiraa e Innde joom ma Oon takɗo denndaangal ko taga ko.

versets.arabic_text: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ
versets.translation: Takɗo aade e ɗiiƴam petndiɗam caggal nde o woni toɓɓere.

versets.arabic_text: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ
versets.translation: janngu-aan nelaaɗo- ko Alla wahyoto ma ko, e joom ma ɓurɗo teddude Mbo alah fof ɓadiiɗo teddungal Makko, ko O keewɗo dokke.

versets.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ
versets.translation: Oon ganndanirɗo binndol e winndirde kuɗol.

versets.arabic_text: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ
versets.translation: O anndini neɗɗo ko o anndaa.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Ko goongo aade saay saay hono Abu jahli na yawta keerol e nanngitde keeri Alla.

versets.arabic_text: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Sabu si o yi*ii o yondaniima ko o dañi ko jawdi e koongu.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Pellet ko e joom ma-aan aade- woni ruttorde ñande darnga, O yoɓa mbo kala ko o haandi ko.

versets.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ
versets.translation: Mbela a yi*ii ko ɓuri haawnaade e fiyaaku Abu jahli oon kaɗoowo.

versets.arabic_text: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
versets.translation: Maccuɗo amen si o juulii ka kaaba.

versets.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
versets.translation: A yi*ii si Oon kaɗaaɗo laatiima e peewal ummaade e joom makko?

versets.arabic_text: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ
versets.translation: Wollo o woni hombo yamira yimɓe kulol Alla e siinude ko Alla yamiri e deestaade ko O haɗi, mbela hombo haɗa mbo nih woni fiyaaku mum?

versets.arabic_text: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
versets.translation: Mbela yi*i si o fennii o kaɗoowo ko nelaaɗo addi ko,o ɗuurnii ɗum, mbela o hulath Alla?

versets.arabic_text: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
versets.translation: Mbela o kaɗoowo maccude juulde anndah wonde Alla na yi*a ko o gollata ko, hay ndiga wirnaaki Mbo?

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
versets.translation: Fiyaaku o wonah no majjuɗo sikkirta, si accaani lorlude maccuɗo Amen o e fennude mbo, ma Min nanngu mbo Min mbippa mbo faade e yiite e tiin tiinol makoo ko satti.

versets.arabic_text: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ
versets.translation: jom tiin tiinol o penoowo e konngol, goopɗo e golle.

versets.arabic_text: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
versets.translation: Yo o noddu saanga o nanngate e tiin tiinol faade yiite wondiiɓe mum e joodoɗiiɓe mum o wallinoo ɓe ngam danndeede.

versets.arabic_text: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
versets.translation: Ma Min noddu sokooɓe jahannama ummaade malayka en tekkuɓe ɓe ngoopatah Alla ko O yamiri ɓe, hoɓe ngolla ko O yamiri, ndaare hombo e pelle he ɓuri semmbinde e hattande.

versets.arabic_text: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩
versets.translation: Fiyaaku o wonah no tooñoowo sikkiri nih nde o yottinta ma bonannde, woto ɗofto mbo e yamiroore mum e haɗde mum, sujjan Alla, ɓadoroɗaa Mbo dewe.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
versets.translation: Min tellinii Quraana e na tonnga faade e kammu ɓurɗo ɓadaade hono no Min puɗɗorno tellide mbo e Annabi-yo o his- e jemma leylatul qadiri nder lewru koorko.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
versets.translation: Mbela ana anndi-aan nelaaɗo- ko woni e hembo e moƴƴere e barke?

versets.arabic_text: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
versets.translation: O jemma mawdo moƴƴere, ɓuri ujnere lewru moƴƴude sabu ko woni e hembo e iimaan e fawaade e Alla.

versets.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
versets.translation: Malaukaaji na telloo jibriil kadi telloo heen e sakkitoore joom mum en Ceniiɗo e kala yamiroore nde Alla ñaawi e ndeen hitaande foti ko arsuka wolla maayde wolla jibinegol eka nanndi heen.

versets.arabic_text: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ
versets.translation: O jemma barkinaaɗo ko mbo moƴƴere kammba fof gila arwannde haa sakket hembo haa feeral wenndoogo.

versets.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
versets.translation: Wonaana ɓeen heeferɓe jom defte en ummaade e Yahuud e Nasaara en e sirkuɓe seertuɓe pottal e dental e dow keefeeru haa ari e mum en dallillaaaji laaɓtuɗi e hujju ɓannguɗi.

versets.arabic_text: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
versets.translation: O daliil laaɓtuɗo woni nelaaɗo ummiiɗo e Alla, O neli Mbo hombo jannga ɗeri laɓɓinaaɗi memataa ɗi si wonah laɓɓinaaɓe.

versets.arabic_text: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ
versets.translation: Ina e ɗiin ɗereeji kabaruuji e ñaawooje nuunɗuɗe, peewnooje e ko woni jam e peewal.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
versets.translation: Luuraani Yahuud tottaaɓe Tawreeta e Nasaara tottaaɓe Injiil, si wonah caggal nde Alla neli Annabi makko faade e mum en, ina heen jebbelii ɓe, ina heen kadi dooniiɓe e keefeeru wondude e anndude ɓe goonɗude Annabi Makko.

versets.arabic_text: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
versets.translation: Ina ɓannga canndallaagal Yahuud e Nasaara ɓe njamiraaka e Quraana si wonah koɓe njamira e defte mum en ɗuum woni rewde Alla kanko tan, e deestaade sirku, e tottirede juulde e askal, koɓe njamiraa ko woni diine poocciiɗo mbo ooñaaki.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓeen heeferɓe yahuud en e nasaara en e sirkuɓe, maɓe naat ñande ndarnga yiite jahatnama ɓe ngona toon haa pooma, ko ɓeen ngoni ko ɓuri bonde e tagoore he, sabu koɓe njeddi ko Alla e fennuude ɓe nelaaɓe.

versets.arabic_text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
versets.translation: Pellet ɓeen goonɗinɓe ɓe ngoli ko lobbi, ɓeen ngoni ko ɓuri moƴƴude e tagoore he.
